name: subLimbs_spec
statement:
theorem subLimbs_spec (a b : Limbs8) (ha : a.Bounded) (hb : b.Bounded) :
    (subBorrow a b).toNat ≤ 1 ∧
      (subLimbs a b).toNat + b.toNat = a.toNat + 2 ^ 256 * (subBorrow a b).toNat
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha0, ha1, ha2, ha3, ha4, ha5, ha6, ha7⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨hb0, hb1, hb2, hb3, hb4, hb5, hb6, hb7⟩ := hb
  obtain ⟨d0, c0, dd0, dc0, e0, gc0, hd0⟩ :=
    sbb_spec a.l0 b.l0 (0 : UInt64) ha0 hb0 (by decide)
  obtain ⟨d1, c1, dd1, dc1, e1, gc1, hd1⟩ :=
    sbb_spec a.l1 b.l1 _ ha1 hb1 (dc0 ▸ gc0)
  obtain ⟨d2, c2, dd2, dc2, e2, gc2, hd2⟩ :=
    sbb_spec a.l2 b.l2 _ ha2 hb2 (dc1 ▸ gc1)
  obtain ⟨d3, c3, dd3, dc3, e3, gc3, hd3⟩ :=
    sbb_spec a.l3 b.l3 _ ha3 hb3 (dc2 ▸ gc2)
  obtain ⟨d4, c4, dd4, dc4, e4, gc4, hd4⟩ :=
    sbb_spec a.l4 b.l4 _ ha4 hb4 (dc3 ▸ gc3)
  obtain ⟨d5, c5, dd5, dc5, e5, gc5, hd5⟩ :=
    sbb_spec a.l5 b.l5 _ ha5 hb5 (dc4 ▸ gc4)
  obtain ⟨d6, c6, dd6, dc6, e6, gc6, hd6⟩ :=
    sbb_spec a.l6 b.l6 _ ha6 hb6 (dc5 ▸ gc5)
  obtain ⟨d7, c7, dd7, dc7, e7, gc7, hd7⟩ :=
    sbb_spec a.l7 b.l7 _ ha7 hb7 (dc6 ▸ gc6)
  simp only [dc0, dc1, dc2, dc3, dc4, dc5, dc6, toNat_zero] at e0 e1 e2 e3 e4 e5 e6 e7
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [subBorrow, dc7]
    exact gc7
  · simp only [subLimbs, subBorrow, Limbs8.toNat, dd0, dd1, dd2, dd3, dd4, dd5, dd6, dd7,
      dc7]
    have h := borrow_chain_sum e0 e1 e2 e3 e4 e5 e6 e7
    simp only [Nat.add_zero] at h
    exact h

name: condSub_bounded
statement: theorem condSub_bounded (q t : Limbs8) (ht : t.Bounded) : (condSub q t).Bounded
proof:
:= by
  simp only [condSub]
  split
  · exact subLimbs_bounded t q
  · exact ht

name: condSub_toNat
statement:
theorem condSub_toNat (q t : Limbs8) (hq : q.Bounded) (ht : t.Bounded) :
    (condSub q t).toNat = if t.toNat < q.toNat then t.toNat else t.toNat - q.toNat
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hbo, hchain⟩ := subLimbs_spec t q ht hq
  have hD := Limbs8.toNat_lt (subLimbs_bounded t q)
  simp only [condSub, beq_iff_eq, ← UInt64.toNat_inj, toNat_zero]
  split
  case isTrue h =>
    rw [h, Nat.mul_zero, Nat.add_zero] at hchain
    exact cond_of_borrow_zero hchain hD
  case isFalse h =>
    rw [show (subBorrow t q).toNat = 1 by omega, Nat.mul_one] at hchain
    exact cond_of_borrow_one hchain hD

name: condSub_lt
statement:
theorem condSub_lt (q t : Limbs8) (hq : q.Bounded) (ht : t.Bounded)
    (h : t.toNat < 2 * q.toNat) : (condSub q t).toNat < q.toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [condSub_toNat q t hq ht]
  split <;> omega

name: add_bounded
statement: theorem add_bounded (q a b : Limbs8) : (add q a b).Bounded
proof:
:=
  condSub_bounded _ _ (addLimbs_bounded a b)

name: sub_bounded
statement: theorem sub_bounded (q a b : Limbs8) : (sub q a b).Bounded
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sub]
  split
  · exact subLimbs_bounded a b
  · exact addLimbs_bounded _ _

name: neg_bounded
statement: theorem neg_bounded (q a : Limbs8) : (neg q a).Bounded
proof: := sub_bounded _ _ _

name: add_toNat
statement:
theorem add_toNat (q a b : Limbs8) (hq : q.Bounded) (ha : a.Bounded) (hb : b.Bounded)
    (hq2 : 2 * q.toNat < 2 ^ 256) (haq : a.toNat < q.toNat) (hbq : b.toNat < q.toNat) :
    (add q a b).toNat = (a.toNat + b.toNat) % q.toNat
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hchain⟩ := addLimbs_toNat a b ha hb
  obtain ⟨hsum, hlt⟩ :=
    carry_top_zero hchain (Limbs8.toNat_lt (addLimbs_bounded a b)) haq hbq hq2
  simp only [add]
  rw [condSub_toNat q _ hq (addLimbs_bounded a b), hsum]
  rw [hsum] at hlt
  exact cond_eq_mod hlt

name: add_lt
statement:
theorem add_lt (q a b : Limbs8) (hq : q.Bounded) (ha : a.Bounded) (hb : b.Bounded)
    (hq2 : 2 * q.toNat < 2 ^ 256) (haq : a.toNat < q.toNat) (hbq : b.toNat < q.toNat) :
    (add q a b).toNat < q.toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_toNat q a b hq ha hb hq2 haq hbq]
  exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)

name: sub_toNat
statement:
theorem sub_toNat (q a b : Limbs8) (hq : q.Bounded) (ha : a.Bounded) (hb : b.Bounded)
    (hq2 : 2 * q.toNat < 2 ^ 256) (haq : a.toNat < q.toNat) (hbq : b.toNat < q.toNat) :
    (sub q a b).toNat = (a.toNat + (q.toNat - b.toNat)) % q.toNat
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hbo, hchain⟩ := subLimbs_spec a b ha hb
  have hD := Limbs8.toNat_lt (subLimbs_bounded a b)
  simp only [sub, beq_iff_eq, ← UInt64.toNat_inj, toNat_zero]
  split
  case isTrue h =>
    rw [h] at hchain
    exact sub_of_borrow_zero hchain hbq haq
  case isFalse h =>
    rw [show (subBorrow a b).toNat = 1 by omega] at hchain
    obtain ⟨c, _, hchainE⟩ := addLimbs_toNat _ q (subLimbs_bounded a b) hq
    exact sub_of_borrow_one hchain hchainE hD
      (Limbs8.toNat_lt (addLimbs_bounded _ _)) hbq haq hq2

name: sub_lt
statement:
theorem sub_lt (q a b : Limbs8) (hq : q.Bounded) (ha : a.Bounded) (hb : b.Bounded)
    (hq2 : 2 * q.toNat < 2 ^ 256) (haq : a.toNat < q.toNat) (hbq : b.toNat < q.toNat) :
    (sub q a b).toNat < q.toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_toNat q a b hq ha hb hq2 haq hbq]
  exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)

name: neg_toNat
statement:
theorem neg_toNat (q a : Limbs8) (hq : q.Bounded) (ha : a.Bounded)
    (hq2 : 2 * q.toNat < 2 ^ 256) (haq : a.toNat < q.toNat) :
    (neg q a).toNat = (q.toNat - a.toNat) % q.toNat
proof:
:= by
  simp only [neg]
  rw [sub_toNat q Limbs8.zero a hq Limbs8.zero_bounded ha hq2
    (by rw [Limbs8.zero_toNat]; omega) haq, Limbs8.zero_toNat, Nat.zero_add]

name: neg_lt
statement:
theorem neg_lt (q a : Limbs8) (hq : q.Bounded) (ha : a.Bounded)
    (hq2 : 2 * q.toNat < 2 ^ 256) (haq : a.toNat < q.toNat) : (neg q a).toNat < q.toNat
proof:
:=
  sub_lt q Limbs8.zero a hq Limbs8.zero_bounded ha hq2
    (by rw [Limbs8.zero_toNat]; omega) haq

name: modulus_pos
statement: theorem modulus_pos : 0 < modulus
proof: := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt P.two_lt_modulus

name: modulus_lt
statement: theorem modulus_lt : modulus < 2 ^ 256
proof:
:= by
  have := P.two_mul_modulus_lt
  omega

name: q_toNat
statement: theorem q_toNat : P.modulusLimbs.toNat = modulus
proof: := P.modulusLimbs_toNat

name: two_mul_q_lt
statement: theorem two_mul_q_lt : 2 * P.modulusLimbs.toNat < 2 ^ 256
proof:
:= by
  rw [q_toNat]
  exact P.two_mul_modulus_lt

name: negInv_mul_q
statement: theorem negInv_mul_q : P.montgomeryNegInv.toNat * P.modulusLimbs.toNat % 2 ^ 32 = 2 ^ 32 - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [q_toNat]
  exact P.montgomeryNegInv_mul_modulus_mod_two_pow_32

name: two_ne_zero
statement: theorem two_ne_zero : (2 : ZMod modulus) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hdvd : modulus ∣ 2 := (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff 2 modulus).mp h
  exact (Nat.not_le_of_gt P.two_lt_modulus) (Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide) hdvd)

name: r_ne_zero
statement: theorem r_ne_zero : ((2 ^ 256 : ℕ) : ZMod modulus) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  exact pow_ne_zero _ two_ne_zero

name: val_bounded
statement: theorem val_bounded (x : FastField modulus) : x.val.Bounded
proof: := x.property.1

name: val_lt
statement: theorem val_lt (x : FastField modulus) : x.val.toNat < P.modulusLimbs.toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [Mont64x8Field.q_toNat]
  exact x.property.2

name: zero_def
statement: theorem zero_def : (0 : FastField modulus) = FastField.zero modulus
proof: := rfl

name: one_def
statement: theorem one_def : (1 : FastField modulus) = FastField.one modulus
proof: := rfl

name: add_def
statement: theorem add_def (x y : FastField modulus) : x + y = FastField.add x y
proof: := rfl

name: neg_def
statement: theorem neg_def (x : FastField modulus) : -x = FastField.neg x
proof: := rfl

name: sub_def
statement: theorem sub_def (x y : FastField modulus) : x - y = FastField.sub x y
proof: := rfl

name: mul_def
statement: theorem mul_def (x y : FastField modulus) : x * y = FastField.mul x y
proof: := rfl

name: inv_def
statement: theorem inv_def (x : FastField modulus) : x⁻¹ = FastField.inv x
proof: := rfl

name: div_def
statement: theorem div_def (x y : FastField modulus) : x / y = x * y⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: square_def
statement: theorem square_def (x : FastField modulus) : FastField.square x = x * x
proof: := rfl

name: mul_cast
statement:
private theorem mul_cast (x y : Limbs8) (hx : x.Bounded) (hy : y.Bounded)
    (hxq : x.toNat < modulus) :
    ((Native64x8.mul P.modulusLimbs P.montgomeryNegInv x y).toNat : ZMod modulus) =
      (x.toNat : ZMod modulus) * (y.toNat : ZMod modulus) *
        ((2 ^ 256 : ℕ) : ZMod modulus)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hmod := (mul_spec _ _ _ _ P.modulusLimbs_bounded hx hy P.montgomeryNegInv_lt
    Mont64x8Field.negInv_mul_q (by rw [Mont64x8Field.q_toNat]; exact hxq)
    Mont64x8Field.two_mul_q_lt).2.2
  rw [Mont64x8Field.q_toNat] at hmod
  have hcast := (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff _ _ _).2 hmod
  rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul] at hcast
  rw [← hcast, mul_comm ((2 ^ 256 : ℕ) : ZMod modulus), mul_assoc,
    mul_inv_cancel₀ Mont64x8Field.r_ne_zero, mul_one]

name: toField_eq
statement:
private theorem toField_eq (x : FastField modulus) :
    toField x = (x.val.toNat : ZMod modulus) * ((2 ^ 256 : ℕ) : ZMod modulus)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [toField, toNat, toLimbs8,
    mul_cast x.val Limbs8.one x.val_bounded Limbs8.one_bounded x.property.2, Limbs8.one_toNat]
  simp

name: val_cast
statement:
private theorem val_cast (x : FastField modulus) :
    (x.val.toNat : ZMod modulus) = toField x * ((2 ^ 256 : ℕ) : ZMod modulus)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toField_eq, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ Mont64x8Field.r_ne_zero, mul_one]

name: toNat_lt
statement: theorem toNat_lt (x : FastField modulus) : toNat x < modulus
proof:
:= by
  have := (mul_spec _ _ _ _ P.modulusLimbs_bounded x.val_bounded Limbs8.one_bounded
    P.montgomeryNegInv_lt Mont64x8Field.negInv_mul_q x.val_lt Mont64x8Field.two_mul_q_lt).2.1
  rwa [Mont64x8Field.q_toNat] at this

name: ofCanonicalNat_val_cast
proof:
:= by
  have hR2 : ((((2 ^ 256) ^ 2 : ℕ) % modulus : ℕ) : ZMod modulus)
      = ((2 ^ 256 : ℕ) : ZMod modulus) * ((2 ^ 256 : ℕ) : ZMod modulus) := by
    rw [ZMod.natCast_mod, pow_two, Nat.cast_mul]
  rw [ofCanonicalNat,
    mul_cast _ _ (Limbs8.ofNat_bounded n) P.r2ModModulus_bounded
      (by rw [Limbs8.ofNat_toNat, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (h.trans Mont64x8Field.modulus_lt)]; exact h),
    Limbs8.ofNat_toNat, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (h.trans Mont64x8Field.modulus_lt),
    P.r2ModModulus_toNat, hR2, mul_assoc, mul_assoc,
    mul_inv_cancel₀ Mont64x8Field.r_ne_zero, mul_one]

name: toField_ofCanonicalNat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_ofCanonicalNat {n : ℕ} (h : n < modulus) :
    toField (ofCanonicalNat n h) = (n : ZMod modulus)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toField_eq, ofCanonicalNat_val_cast h, mul_assoc,
    mul_inv_cancel₀ Mont64x8Field.r_ne_zero, mul_one]

name: toNat_ofCanonicalNat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toNat_ofCanonicalNat {n : ℕ} (h : n < modulus) : toNat (ofCanonicalNat n h) = n
proof:
:=
  Montgomery.natCast_inj_of_lt (toField_ofCanonicalNat h) (toNat_lt _) h

name: toField_ofField
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_ofField (x : ZMod modulus) : toField (ofField x) = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [ofField, toField_ofCanonicalNat]

name: ofField_toField
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofField_toField (x : FastField modulus) : ofField (toField x) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hlt : ∀ y : FastField modulus, y.val.toNat < 2 ^ 256 := fun y =>
    Limbs8.toNat_lt y.val_bounded
  have hval : ((ofField (toField x)).val.toNat : ZMod modulus) = (x.val.toNat : ZMod modulus) := by
    rw [val_cast, val_cast, toField_ofField]
  have hnat : (ofField (toField x)).val.toNat = x.val.toNat :=
    Montgomery.natCast_inj_of_lt hval (ofField (toField x)).property.2 x.property.2
  exact Limbs8.ext_of_toNat (ofField (toField x)).val_bounded x.val_bounded hnat

name: toField_injective
statement: theorem toField_injective : Function.Injective (toField (modulus := modulus))
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective ofField_toField

name: toField_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_zero : toField (0 : FastField modulus) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [toField_eq, zero_def, zero]
  simp [Limbs8.zero_toNat]

name: toField_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_one : toField (1 : FastField modulus) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [toField_eq, one_def, one]
  simp only [P.rModModulus_toNat, ZMod.natCast_mod]
  exact mul_inv_cancel₀ Mont64x8Field.r_ne_zero

name: toField_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_add (x y : FastField modulus) : toField (x + y) = toField x + toField y
proof:
:= by
  rw [toField_eq, toField_eq x, toField_eq y, add_def, add]
  have h := add_toNat P.modulusLimbs x.val y.val P.modulusLimbs_bounded x.val_bounded
    y.val_bounded Mont64x8Field.two_mul_q_lt x.val_lt y.val_lt
  rw [h, Mont64x8Field.q_toNat, ZMod.natCast_mod, Nat.cast_add]
  ring

name: toField_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_sub (x y : FastField modulus) : toField (x - y) = toField x - toField y
proof:
:= by
  rw [toField_eq, toField_eq x, toField_eq y, sub_def, sub]
  have h := sub_toNat P.modulusLimbs x.val y.val P.modulusLimbs_bounded x.val_bounded
    y.val_bounded Mont64x8Field.two_mul_q_lt x.val_lt y.val_lt
  rw [h, Mont64x8Field.q_toNat, ZMod.natCast_mod, Nat.cast_add,
    Nat.cast_sub (le_of_lt y.property.2), ZMod.natCast_self]
  ring

name: toField_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_neg (x : FastField modulus) : toField (-x) = -toField x
proof:
:= by
  rw [toField_eq, toField_eq x, neg_def, neg]
  have h := neg_toNat P.modulusLimbs x.val P.modulusLimbs_bounded x.val_bounded
    Mont64x8Field.two_mul_q_lt x.val_lt
  rw [h, Mont64x8Field.q_toNat, ZMod.natCast_mod, Nat.cast_sub (le_of_lt x.property.2),
    ZMod.natCast_self]
  ring

name: toField_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_mul (x y : FastField modulus) : toField (x * y) = toField x * toField y
proof:
:= by
  rw [toField_eq, toField_eq x, toField_eq y, mul_def, mul,
    mul_cast x.val y.val x.val_bounded y.val_bounded x.property.2]
  ring

name: mul_assoc'
statement: private theorem mul_assoc' (x y z : FastField modulus) : x * y * z = x * (y * z)
proof:
:= by
  apply toField_injective
  rw [toField_mul, toField_mul, toField_mul, toField_mul]
  ring

name: pow_succ_field
statement: private theorem pow_succ_field (x : FastField modulus) (n : ℕ) : pow x (n + 1) = pow x n * x
proof:
:= by
  unfold pow
  let : Semigroup (FastField modulus) := { mul, mul_assoc := mul_assoc' }
  exact npowBinRec_succ n x

name: toField_square
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_square (x : FastField modulus) : toField (square x) = toField x * toField x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [square_def, toField_mul]

name: toField_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_pow (x : FastField modulus) (n : ℕ) : toField (pow x n) = toField x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      unfold pow
      rw [npowBinRec_zero, toField_one]
      simp
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ_field, toField_mul, ih, _root_.pow_succ]

name: inv_eq_pow
statement: private theorem inv_eq_pow {a : ZMod modulus} (ha : a ≠ 0) : a⁻¹ = a ^ (modulus - 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : Fintype.card (ZMod modulus) = modulus := ZMod.card modulus
  have h1 : a ^ (modulus - 1) = 1 := by
    have h := FiniteField.pow_card_sub_one_eq_one a ha
    rw [hcard] at h
    exact h
  have hmul : a * a ^ (modulus - 2) = 1 := by
    rw [← pow_succ']
    show a ^ (modulus - 2 + 1) = 1
    have hsucc : modulus - 2 + 1 = modulus - 1 := by
      have := P.two_lt_modulus
      omega
    rw [hsucc]
    exact h1
  exact (eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left (by rwa [mul_comm])).symm

name: toField_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_inv (x : FastField modulus) : toField x⁻¹ = (toField x)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp only [inv_def, inv, toField_pow]
  by_cases hx : toField x = 0
  · rw [hx, inv_zero, zero_pow]
    have := P.two_lt_modulus
    omega
  · rw [inv_eq_pow hx]

name: toField_div
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_div (x y : FastField modulus) : toField (x / y) = toField x / toField y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [div_def, toField_mul, toField_inv]
  rfl

name: toField_natCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_natCast (n : ℕ) : toField (n : FastField modulus) = (n : ZMod modulus)
proof:
:= by
  change toField (ofNat modulus n) = (n : ZMod modulus)
  rw [ofNat, toField_ofCanonicalNat, ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff]
  exact Nat.mod_modEq _ _

name: toField_intCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_intCast (n : Int) : toField (n : FastField modulus) = (n : ZMod modulus)
proof:
:= by
  change toField (ofField n) = (n : ZMod modulus)
  rw [toField_ofField]

name: toField_nsmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_nsmul (n : ℕ) (x : FastField modulus) : toField (n • x) = n • toField x
proof:
:= by
  change toField ((n : FastField modulus) * x) = n • toField x
  rw [toField_mul, toField_natCast, nsmul_eq_mul]

name: toField_zsmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_zsmul (n : Int) (x : FastField modulus) : toField (n • x) = n • toField x
proof:
:= by
  change toField ((n : FastField modulus) * x) = n • toField x
  rw [toField_mul, toField_intCast, zsmul_eq_mul]

name: toField_npow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_npow (x : FastField modulus) (n : ℕ) : toField (x ^ n) = toField x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  change toField (pow x n) = toField x ^ n
  rw [toField_pow]

name: toField_zpow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_zpow (x : FastField modulus) (n : Int) : toField (x ^ n) = toField x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | ofNat n =>
      change toField (pow x n) = toField x ^ (Int.ofNat n)
      rw [toField_pow]
      exact (zpow_natCast (toField x) n).symm
  | negSucc n =>
      change toField (pow (inv x) (n + 1)) = toField x ^ (Int.negSucc n)
      have hinv : toField (inv x) = (toField x)⁻¹ := by
        change toField x⁻¹ = (toField x)⁻¹
        rw [toField_inv]
      rw [toField_pow, hinv, zpow_negSucc, inv_pow]

name: toField_nnratCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_nnratCast (q : ℚ≥0) : toField (q : FastField modulus) = (q : ZMod modulus)
proof:
:= by
  change toField (ofField (q : ZMod modulus)) = (q : ZMod modulus)
  rw [toField_ofField]

name: toField_ratCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_ratCast (q : ℚ) : toField (q : FastField modulus) = (q : ZMod modulus)
proof:
:= by
  change toField (ofField (q : ZMod modulus)) = (q : ZMod modulus)
  rw [toField_ofField]

name: toField_nnqsmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_nnqsmul (q : ℚ≥0) (x : FastField modulus) : toField (q • x) = q • toField x
proof:
:= by
  change toField (ofField (q • toField x)) = q • toField x
  rw [toField_ofField]

name: toField_qsmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_qsmul (q : ℚ) (x : FastField modulus) : toField (q • x) = q • toField x
proof:
:= by
  change toField (ofField (q • toField x)) = q • toField x
  rw [toField_ofField]

name: ringEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ringEquiv_apply {x : FastField modulus} : ringEquiv modulus x = toField x
proof: := rfl

name: ringEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ringEquiv_symm_apply {x : ZMod modulus} : (ringEquiv modulus).symm x = ofField x
proof: := rfl

name: ScalarField_is_prime
statement: theorem ScalarField_is_prime : Nat.Prime scalarFieldSize
proof:
:= by
  unfold scalarFieldSize
  refine PrattCertificate'.out (p := scalarFieldSize) ⟨5, (by reduce_mod_char), ?_⟩
  refine .split [2 ^ 28, 3 ^ 2, 13, 29, 983, 11003, 237073, 405928799, 1670836401704629,

name: reduceUInt32Lt2ModulusRaw_lt
proof:
:= by
  unfold reduceUInt32Lt2ModulusRaw
  by_cases hx : x < modulus
  · rw [if_pos hx]
    rw [UInt32.lt_iff_toNat_lt, modulus_toNat] at hx
    exact hx
  · rw [if_neg hx]
    have hmod_le_x : modulus ≤ x := by
      rw [UInt32.le_iff_toNat_le, modulus_toNat]
      rw [UInt32.lt_iff_toNat_lt, modulus_toNat] at hx
      exact Nat.le_of_not_gt hx
    rw [UInt32.toNat_sub_of_le _ _ hmod_le_x, modulus_toNat]
    omega

name: reduceUInt32Lt2Modulus_cast
statement:
private theorem reduceUInt32Lt2Modulus_cast (x : UInt32)
    (h : x.toNat < 2 * Mersenne31.fieldSize) :
    ((reduceUInt32Lt2Modulus x h).val.toNat : Mersenne31.Field) =
      (x.toNat : Mersenne31.Field)
proof:
:= by
  change ((reduceUInt32Lt2ModulusRaw x).toNat : Mersenne31.Field) =
    (x.toNat : Mersenne31.Field)
  unfold reduceUInt32Lt2ModulusRaw
  by_cases hx : x < modulus
  · rw [if_pos hx]
  · rw [if_neg hx]
    have hmod_le_x : modulus ≤ x := by
      rw [UInt32.le_iff_toNat_le, modulus_toNat]
      rw [UInt32.lt_iff_toNat_lt, modulus_toNat] at hx
      exact Nat.le_of_not_gt hx
    rw [UInt32.toNat_sub_of_le _ _ hmod_le_x, modulus_toNat]
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by
      rw [UInt32.le_iff_toNat_le, modulus_toNat] at hmod_le_x
      exact hmod_le_x)]
    simp

name: toField_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_add (x y : Field) :
    toField (x + y) = toField x + toField y
proof:
:= by
  unfold instAddField add toField toNat
  have hbound : (x.val + y.val).toNat < 2 * Mersenne31.fieldSize := by
    rw [UInt32.toNat_add]
    have hsum_lt : x.val.toNat + y.val.toNat < UInt32.size := by
      nlinarith [x.property, y.property, fieldSize_add_fieldSize_lt_uint32Size]
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hsum_lt]
    nlinarith [x.property, y.property]
  have hred := reduceUInt32Lt2Modulus_cast (x.val + y.val) hbound
  change ((reduceUInt32Lt2ModulusRaw (x.val + y.val)).toNat :
      Mersenne31.Field) =
        ((x.val + y.val).toNat : Mersenne31.Field) at hred
  change ((reduceUInt32Lt2ModulusRaw (x.val + y.val)).toNat :
      Mersenne31.Field) =
        (x.val.toNat : Mersenne31.Field) + (y.val.toNat : Mersenne31.Field)
  rw [hred]
  rw [UInt32.toNat_add]
  have hsum_lt : x.val.toNat + y.val.toNat < UInt32.size := by
    nlinarith [x.property, y.property, fieldSize_add_fieldSize_lt_uint32Size]
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hsum_lt]
  rw [Nat.cast_add]

name: toField_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_sub (x y : Field) : toField (x - y) = toField x - toField y
proof:
:= by
  change (((sub x y).val.toNat : Mersenne31.Field) =
    (x.val.toNat : Mersenne31.Field) - (y.val.toNat : Mersenne31.Field))
  unfold sub
  by_cases hxy : x.val ≥ y.val
  · rw [dif_pos hxy]
    rw [UInt32.toNat_sub_of_le _ _ hxy]
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by
      rw [ge_iff_le, UInt32.le_iff_toNat_le] at hxy
      exact hxy)]
  · rw [dif_neg hxy]
    have hsum_lt : x.val.toNat + Mersenne31.fieldSize < UInt32.size := by
      nlinarith [x.property, fieldSize_add_fieldSize_lt_uint32Size]
    have hsum_eq :
        (x.val + modulus).toNat = x.val.toNat + Mersenne31.fieldSize := by
      rw [UInt32.toNat_add, modulus_toNat, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hsum_lt]
    have hy_le_sum : y.val ≤ x.val + modulus := by
      rw [UInt32.le_iff_toNat_le, hsum_eq]
      omega
    rw [UInt32.toNat_sub_of_le _ _ hy_le_sum, hsum_eq]
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by
      rw [UInt32.le_iff_toNat_le, hsum_eq] at hy_le_sum
      exact hy_le_sum)]
    rw [Nat.cast_add]
    simp

name: toField_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_neg (x : Field) : toField (-x) = -toField x
proof:
:= by
  change (((neg x).val.toNat : Mersenne31.Field) =
    -(x.val.toNat : Mersenne31.Field))
  unfold neg
  by_cases hx : x.val = 0
  · rw [dif_pos hx]
    have hxNat : x.val.toNat = 0 := by
      simpa using congrArg UInt32.toNat hx
    rw [hxNat]
    change ((toNat (0 : Field) : Mersenne31.Field)) = 0
    rw [toNat_zero]
    simp
  · rw [dif_neg hx]
    have hle : x.val ≤ modulus := by
      rw [UInt32.le_iff_toNat_le, modulus_toNat]
      exact Nat.le_of_lt x.property
    rw [UInt32.toNat_sub_of_le _ _ hle, modulus_toNat]
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by
      rw [UInt32.le_iff_toNat_le, modulus_toNat] at hle
      exact hle)]
    rw [ZMod.natCast_self]
    simp

name: reduceUInt64Raw_split_toNat
statement:
private theorem reduceUInt64Raw_split_toNat (x : UInt64)
    (hsum_lt_uint32 : x.toNat % 2 ^ 31 + x.toNat / 2 ^ 31 < 2 ^ 32) :
    ((x &&& modulus64) + (x >>> 31)).toUInt32.toNat =
      x.toNat % 2 ^ 31 + x.toNat / 2 ^ 31
proof:
:= by
  simp only [UInt64.toNat_toUInt32, UInt64.toNat_add, UInt64.toNat_and,
    UInt64.toNat_shiftRight, modulus64_toNat, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
  rw [show Mersenne31.fieldSize = 2 ^ 31 - 1 by decide]
  rw [show UInt64.toNat 31 % 64 = 31 by decide]
  rw [Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod]
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.lt_trans hsum_lt_uint32 (by decide : 2 ^ 32 < 2 ^ 64))]
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hsum_lt_uint32]

name: reduceUInt64_split_sum_bounds
statement:
private theorem reduceUInt64_split_sum_bounds (x : UInt64)
    (h : x.toNat < Mersenne31.fieldSize * Mersenne31.fieldSize) :
    x.toNat % 2 ^ 31 + x.toNat / 2 ^ 31 < 2 * Mersenne31.fieldSize ∧
      x.toNat % 2 ^ 31 + x.toNat / 2 ^ 31 < 2 ^ 32
proof:
:= by
  have hlow_le : x.toNat % 2 ^ 31 ≤ Mersenne31.fieldSize := by
    have hlow_lt : x.toNat % 2 ^ 31 < 2 ^ 31 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
    have hfield : Mersenne31.fieldSize = 2 ^ 31 - 1 := by
      decide
    omega
  have hhi_lt : x.toNat / 2 ^ 31 < Mersenne31.fieldSize := by
    rw [Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul]
    · have hfield_lt_pow31 : Mersenne31.fieldSize < 2 ^ 31 := by
        decide
      nlinarith [h, hfield_lt_pow31, fieldSize_pos]
    · decide
  have hsum_lt_two_fieldSize :
      x.toNat % 2 ^ 31 + x.toNat / 2 ^ 31 < 2 * Mersenne31.fieldSize := by
    have hsum := Nat.add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt hlow_le hhi_lt
    nlinarith
  have htwo_lt_uint32 : 2 * Mersenne31.fieldSize < 2 ^ 32 := by
    simpa [UInt32.size, two_mul] using fieldSize_add_fieldSize_lt_uint32Size
  exact ⟨hsum_lt_two_fieldSize, Nat.lt_trans hsum_lt_two_fieldSize htwo_lt_uint32⟩

name: reduceUInt64Raw_lt
proof:
:= by
  unfold reduceUInt64Raw
  apply reduceUInt32Lt2ModulusRaw_lt
  obtain ⟨hsum_lt_two_fieldSize, hsum_lt_uint32⟩ := reduceUInt64_split_sum_bounds x h
  rw [reduceUInt64Raw_split_toNat x hsum_lt_uint32]
  exact hsum_lt_two_fieldSize

name: reduceUInt64_cast
statement:
private theorem reduceUInt64_cast (x : UInt64)
    (h : x.toNat < Mersenne31.fieldSize * Mersenne31.fieldSize) :
    ((reduceUInt64 x h).val.toNat : Mersenne31.Field) =
      (x.toNat : Mersenne31.Field)
proof:
:= by
  change ((reduceUInt64Raw x).toNat : Mersenne31.Field) =
    (x.toNat : Mersenne31.Field)
  unfold reduceUInt64Raw
  obtain ⟨hsum_lt_two_fieldSize, hsum_lt_uint32⟩ := reduceUInt64_split_sum_bounds x h
  have hword :
      ((x &&& modulus64) + (x >>> 31)).toUInt32.toNat =
        x.toNat % 2 ^ 31 + x.toNat / 2 ^ 31 :=
    reduceUInt64Raw_split_toNat x hsum_lt_uint32
  have hred := reduceUInt32Lt2Modulus_cast
    ((x &&& modulus64) + (x >>> 31)).toUInt32 (by
      rw [hword]
      exact hsum_lt_two_fieldSize)
  change ((reduceUInt32Lt2ModulusRaw
      ((x &&& modulus64) + (x >>> 31)).toUInt32).toNat :
        Mersenne31.Field) =
      (((x &&& modulus64) + (x >>> 31)).toUInt32.toNat :
        Mersenne31.Field) at hred
  rw [hred, hword]
  conv_rhs => rw [← Nat.mod_add_div x.toNat (2 ^ 31)]
  rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul]
  have hpow : ((2 ^ 31 : Nat) : Mersenne31.Field) = 1 := by
    decide
  rw [hpow, one_mul, add_comm]

name: toField_reduceUInt64
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem toField_reduceUInt64 (x : UInt64)
    (h : x.toNat < Mersenne31.fieldSize * Mersenne31.fieldSize) :
    toField (reduceUInt64 x h) = (x.toNat : Mersenne31.Field)
proof:
:= by
  exact reduceUInt64_cast x h

name: toField_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_mul (x y : Field) : toField (x * y) = toField x * toField y
proof:
:= by
  change toField (mul x y) = toField x * toField y
  unfold mul
  rw [toField_reduceUInt64]
  simp only [UInt64.toNat_mul, UInt32.toNat_toUInt64]
  have hprod : x.val.toNat * y.val.toNat < 2 ^ 64 := by
    nlinarith [x.property, y.property, fieldSize_mul_fieldSize_lt_two64]
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hprod]
  rw [Nat.cast_mul]
  rfl

name: toField_square
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_square (x : Field) : toField (square x) = toField x * toField x
proof:
:= by
  unfold square
  exact toField_mul x x

name: mul_assoc_field
statement: private theorem mul_assoc_field (x y z : Field) : (x * y) * z = x * (y * z)
proof:
:= by
  apply toField_injective
  rw [toField_mul, toField_mul, toField_mul, toField_mul]
  ring

name: pow_succ
statement: private theorem pow_succ (x : Field) (n : Nat) : pow x (n + 1) = pow x n * x
proof:
:= by
  unfold pow
  let : Semigroup Field := {
    mul := (· * ·)
    mul_assoc := mul_assoc_field
  }
  exact npowBinRec_succ n x

name: toField_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_pow (x : Field) (n : Nat) : toField (pow x n) = toField x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      unfold pow
      rw [npowBinRec_zero]
      rw [toField_one]
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, toField_mul, ih, _root_.pow_succ]

name: gives
statement:
theorem gives `x^(p - 1) = 1`, so `x^(p - 2)` is the multiplicative inverse of
`x`. -/
@[inline]
private def invExponent : Nat
proof: := Mersenne31.fieldSize - 2

name: toField_mul_pow
proof:
:= by
  change toField (x * y) = toField base ^ (m + n)
  rw [toField_mul, hx, hy, ← pow_add]

name: toField_shift4Mul
statement:
private theorem toField_shift4Mul (acc digit : Field) :
    toField (shift4Mul acc digit) = toField acc ^ 16 * toField digit
proof:
:= by
  unfold shift4Mul
  change toField (square (square (square (square acc))) * digit) =
    toField acc ^ 16 * toField digit
  rw [toField_mul]
  repeat rw [toField_square]
  ring

name: toField_shift4Mul_pow
proof:
:= by
  rw [toField_shift4Mul, hacc, hdigit]
  rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
  congr 1
  omega

name: toField_inv_pow
statement:
private theorem toField_inv_pow (x : Field) :
    toField (inv x) = toField x ^ invExponent
proof:
:= by
  unfold inv
  let x2 := square x
  let x3 := mul x2 x
  let x6 := square x3
  let x7 := mul x6 x
  let x13 := mul x7 x6
  let x14 := square x7
  let x15 := mul x14 x
  let acc1 := shift4Mul x7 x15
  let acc2 := shift4Mul acc1 x15
  let acc3 := shift4Mul acc2 x15
  let acc4 := shift4Mul acc3 x15
  let acc5 := shift4Mul acc4 x15
  let acc6 := shift4Mul acc5 x15
  have hx1 : toField x = toField x ^ 1 := by simp
  have hx2 : toField x2 = toField x ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [x2]
    rw [toField_square, pow_two]
  have hx3 : toField x3 = toField x ^ 3 := by
    dsimp [x3]
    simpa using toField_mul_pow x x2 x 2 1 hx2 hx1
  have hx6 : toField x6 = toField x ^ 6 := by
    dsimp [x6]
    rw [toField_square, hx3, ← pow_add]
  have hx7 : toField x7 = toField x ^ 7 := by
    dsimp [x7]
    simpa using toField_mul_pow x x6 x 6 1 hx6 hx1
  have hx13 : toField x13 = toField x ^ 13 := by
    dsimp [x13]
    simpa using toField_mul_pow x x7 x6 7 6 hx7 hx6
  have hx14 : toField x14 = toField x ^ 14 := by
    dsimp [x14]
    rw [toField_square, hx7, ← pow_add]
  have hx15 : toField x15 = toField x ^ 15 := by
    dsimp [x15]
    simpa using toField_mul_pow x x14 x 14 1 hx14 hx1
  have hacc1 : toField acc1 = toField x ^ 127 := by
    dsimp [acc1]
    simpa using toField_shift4Mul_pow x x7 x15 7 15 hx7 hx15
  have hacc2 : toField acc2 = toField x ^ 2047 := by
    dsimp [acc2]
    simpa using toField_shift4Mul_pow x acc1 x15 127 15 hacc1 hx15
  have hacc3 : toField acc3 = toField x ^ 32767 := by
    dsimp [acc3]
    simpa using toField_shift4Mul_pow x acc2 x15 2047 15 hacc2 hx15
  have hacc4 : toField acc4 = toField x ^ 524287 := by
    dsimp [acc4]
    simpa using toField_shift4Mul_pow x acc3 x15 32767 15 hacc3 hx15
  have hacc5 : toField acc5 = toField x ^ 8388607 := by
    dsimp [acc5]
    simpa using toField_shift4Mul_pow x acc4 x15 524287 15 hacc4 hx15
  have hacc6 : toField acc6 = toField x ^ 134217727 := by
    dsimp [acc6]
    simpa using toField_shift4Mul_pow x acc5 x15 8388607 15 hacc5 hx15
  have hfinal := toField_shift4Mul_pow x acc6 x13 134217727 13 hacc6 hx13
  simpa [invExponent, Mersenne31.fieldSize] using hfinal

name: toField_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_inv (x : Field) : toField x⁻¹ = (toField x)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  change toField (inv x) = (toField x)⁻¹
  rw [toField_inv_pow]
  by_cases hx : toField x = 0
  · rw [hx]
    simp [invExponent, Mersenne31.fieldSize]
  · symm
    apply inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right
    calc
      toField x * toField x ^ invExponent = toField x ^ (invExponent + 1) := by
        rw [pow_succ']
      _ = toField x ^ (Mersenne31.fieldSize - 1) := by
        congr 1
      _ = 1 := by
        exact ZMod.pow_card_sub_one_eq_one hx

name: toField_div
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_div (x y : Field) : toField (x / y) = toField x / toField y
proof:
:= by
  change toField (div x y) = toField x / toField y
  unfold div
  change toField (x * inv y) = toField x / toField y
  rw [toField_mul]
  change toField x * toField y⁻¹ = toField x / toField y
  rw [toField_inv]
  rfl

name: toField_nsmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_nsmul (n : Nat) (x : Field) : toField (n • x) = n • toField x
proof:
:= by
  change toField ((n : Field) * x) = n • toField x
  rw [toField_mul, toField_natCast, nsmul_eq_mul]

name: toField_zsmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_zsmul (n : Int) (x : Field) : toField (n • x) = n • toField x
proof:
:= by
  change toField ((n : Field) * x) = n • toField x
  rw [toField_mul, toField_intCast, zsmul_eq_mul]

name: toField_npow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_npow (x : Field) (n : Nat) : toField (x ^ n) = toField x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  change toField (pow x n) = toField x ^ n
  exact toField_pow x n

name: toField_zpow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_zpow (x : Field) (n : Int) : toField (x ^ n) = toField x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | ofNat k =>
      change toField (pow x k) = toField x ^ (k : Int)
      rw [toField_pow, zpow_natCast]
  | negSucc k =>
      change toField (pow (inv x) (k + 1)) = toField x ^ Int.negSucc k
      rw [toField_pow]
      change toField x⁻¹ ^ (k + 1) = toField x ^ Int.negSucc k
      rw [toField_inv, zpow_negSucc, inv_pow]

name: toField_nnqsmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_nnqsmul (q : ℚ≥0) (x : Field) : toField (q • x) = q • toField x

name: toField_qsmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_qsmul (q : ℚ) (x : Field) : toField (q • x) = q • toField x

name: is_prime

proof:
:= by

name: degree_poly
statement: theorem degree_poly : P.poly.degree = (P.d : WithBot ℕ)
proof: := P.degree_poly

name: toQuot_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem toQuot_zero : toQuot (0 : Ext P) = 0
proof: := by simp [toQuot]

name: toQuot_add
statement: @[simp] theorem toQuot_add (x y : Ext P) : toQuot (x + y) = toQuot x + toQuot y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toQuot, coeff_add, map_add, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: toQuot_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem toQuot_neg (x : Ext P) : toQuot (-x) = -toQuot x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toQuot, coeff_neg, map_neg, neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]

name: toQuot_sub
statement: @[simp] theorem toQuot_sub (x y : Ext P) : toQuot (x - y) = toQuot x - toQuot y
proof:

name: toQuot_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem toQuot_smul (c : F) (x : Ext P) :
    toQuot (c • x) = algebraMap F Quot[P] c * toQuot x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toQuot, coeff_smul, map_mul, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]

name: toQuot_one
statement: @[simp] theorem toQuot_one : toQuot (1 : Ext P) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [toQuot, Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem ⟨0, P.d_pos⟩ (Finset.mem_univ _)]
  · simp
  · intro k _ hk
    have : (k : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hk (Fin.ext h)
    simp [this]

name: toQuot_natCast
statement: @[simp] theorem toQuot_natCast (n : ℕ) : toQuot (n : Ext P) = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [toQuot, Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem ⟨0, P.d_pos⟩ (Finset.mem_univ _)]
  · simp
  · intro k _ hk
    have : (k : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hk (Fin.ext h)
    simp [this]

name: toQuot_intCast
statement: @[simp] theorem toQuot_intCast (n : ℤ) : toQuot (n : Ext P) = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [toQuot, Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem ⟨0, P.d_pos⟩ (Finset.mem_univ _)]
  · simp
  · intro k _ hk
    have : (k : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hk (Fin.ext h)
    simp [this]

name: toQuot_eq_mk
statement:
theorem toQuot_eq_mk (x : Ext P) :
    toQuot x = AdjoinRoot.mk P.poly (∑ i : Fin P.d, C (coeff x i) * X ^ (i : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [toQuot, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, AdjoinRoot.mk_C, AdjoinRoot.mk_X, AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq]
  rfl

name: degree_repr_lt
statement:
private theorem degree_repr_lt (x : Ext P) :
    (∑ i : Fin P.d, C (coeff x i) * X ^ (i : ℕ)).degree < P.poly.degree
proof:
:= by
  rw [degree_poly]
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_sum_le _ _) ?_
  rw [Finset.sup_lt_iff (by exact_mod_cast WithBot.bot_lt_coe P.d)]
  intro i _
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_C_mul_X_pow_le _ _) (by exact_mod_cast i.isLt)

name: coeff_repr
statement:
private theorem coeff_repr (x : Ext P) (k : Fin P.d) :
    (∑ i : Fin P.d, C (coeff x i) * X ^ (i : ℕ)).coeff (k : ℕ) = coeff x k
proof:
:= by
  rw [finsetSum_coeff, Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem k (Finset.mem_univ _)]
  · simp
  · intro i _ hi
    rw [coeff_C_mul_X_pow, if_neg (fun h => hi (Fin.ext h.symm))]

name: toQuot_injective
statement: theorem toQuot_injective : Function.Injective (toQuot (P := P))
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  rw [toQuot_eq_mk, toQuot_eq_mk, ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero] at h
  have hzero : (∑ i : Fin P.d, C (coeff x i) * X ^ (i : ℕ))
      - ∑ i : Fin P.d, C (coeff y i) * X ^ (i : ℕ) = 0 :=
    eq_zero_of_dvd_of_degree_lt h
      (lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_sub_le _ _) (max_lt (degree_repr_lt x) (degree_repr_lt y)))
  rw [sub_eq_zero] at hzero
  ext k
  rw [← coeff_repr x k, ← coeff_repr y k, hzero]

name: toQuot_inj
statement: theorem toQuot_inj {x y : Ext P} : toQuot x = toQuot y ↔ x = y
proof:
:=
  toQuot_injective.eq_iff

name: toQuot_rangeForm
statement:
theorem toQuot_rangeForm (x : Ext P) :
    toQuot x = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.d, algebraMap F Quot[P] (coeffNat x k) * (rt P) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [toQuot, ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
    (fun k => algebraMap F Quot[P] (coeffNat x k) * (rt P) ^ k) P.d]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [coeffNat_coe]

name: rt_relation
statement:
theorem rt_relation :
    (rt P) ^ P.d + ∑ i : Fin P.d, algebraMap F Quot[P] (P.lowerCoeff i) * (rt P) ^ (i : ℕ)
      = 0
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : AdjoinRoot.mk P.poly (X ^ P.d) = (rt P) ^ P.d := by
    rw [map_pow, AdjoinRoot.mk_X]; rfl
  have e2 : ∀ i : Fin P.d, AdjoinRoot.mk P.poly (C (P.lowerCoeff i) * X ^ (i : ℕ))
      = algebraMap F Quot[P] (P.lowerCoeff i) * (rt P) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    intro i
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, AdjoinRoot.mk_C, AdjoinRoot.mk_X, AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq]; rfl
  have expand : AdjoinRoot.mk P.poly (X ^ P.d + ∑ i : Fin P.d, C (P.lowerCoeff i) * X ^ (i : ℕ))
      = (rt P) ^ P.d + ∑ i : Fin P.d, algebraMap F Quot[P] (P.lowerCoeff i) * (rt P) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    rw [map_add, e1, map_sum]
    exact congrArg _ (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => e2 i)
  rw [← expand, ← ExtensionParams.poly]
  exact AdjoinRoot.mk_self

name: sum_lower_rangeForm
statement:
theorem sum_lower_rangeForm :
    (∑ m ∈ Finset.range P.d, algebraMap F Quot[P] (P.lowerCoeffNat m) * (rt P) ^ m)
      = -(rt P) ^ P.d
proof:
:= by
  have h := rt_relation (P := P)
  rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
    (fun m => algebraMap F Quot[P] (P.lowerCoeffNat m) * (rt P) ^ m) P.d]
  rw [show (∑ i : Fin P.d, algebraMap F Quot[P] (P.lowerCoeffNat (i : ℕ)) * (rt P) ^ (i : ℕ))
      = ∑ i : Fin P.d, algebraMap F Quot[P] (P.lowerCoeff i) * (rt P) ^ (i : ℕ) from
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [P.lowerCoeffNat_coe]]
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h

name: coeffNat_shiftReduce
statement:
theorem coeffNat_shiftReduce (e : Ext P) {m : ℕ} (h : m < P.d) :
    coeffNat (shiftReduce e) m
      = (if m = 0 then 0 else coeffNat e (m - 1)) - coeffNat e (P.d - 1) * P.lowerCoeffNat m
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeffNat_of_lt _ h, coeff_shiftReduce, ← P.lowerCoeffNat_coe ⟨m, h⟩]

name: toQuot_shiftReduce
statement: theorem toQuot_shiftReduce (e : Ext P) : toQuot (shiftReduce e) = rt P * toQuot e
proof:
:= by
  have hd : P.d = (P.d - 1) + 1 := (Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos P.d_pos).symm
  
  have hRHS : rt P * toQuot e
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range P.d, algebraMap F Quot[P] (coeffNat e i) * (rt P) ^ (i + 1) := by
    rw [toQuot_rangeForm, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [pow_succ]; ring
  
  have hLHS : toQuot (shiftReduce e)
      = (∑ m ∈ Finset.range P.d,
            algebraMap F Quot[P] (if m = 0 then 0 else coeffNat e (m - 1)) * (rt P) ^ m)
        - algebraMap F Quot[P] (coeffNat e (P.d - 1))
            * ∑ m ∈ Finset.range P.d, algebraMap F Quot[P] (P.lowerCoeffNat m) * (rt P) ^ m := by
    rw [toQuot_rangeForm, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm => ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hm
    rw [coeffNat_shiftReduce e hm, map_sub, map_mul]; ring
  
  have hshift : (∑ m ∈ Finset.range P.d,
        algebraMap F Quot[P] (if m = 0 then 0 else coeffNat e (m - 1)) * (rt P) ^ m)
      = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P.d - 1), algebraMap F Quot[P] (coeffNat e k) * (rt P) ^ (k + 1) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hd, Finset.sum_range_succ']
    rw [show (if (0 : ℕ) = 0 then (0 : F) else coeffNat e (0 - 1)) = 0 from if_pos rfl,
      map_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero k), Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  
  have hrhs : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range P.d, algebraMap F Quot[P] (coeffNat e i) * (rt P) ^ (i + 1))
      = (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P.d - 1), algebraMap F Quot[P] (coeffNat e k) * (rt P) ^ (k + 1))
        + algebraMap F Quot[P] (coeffNat e (P.d - 1)) * (rt P) ^ P.d := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hd, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    rw [← hd]
  rw [hLHS, sum_lower_rangeForm, hRHS, hshift, hrhs, mul_neg, sub_neg_eq_add]

name: monomialMod_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem monomialMod_zero : (monomialMod 0 : Ext P) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: monomialMod_succ
statement:
theorem monomialMod_succ (k : ℕ) :
    (monomialMod (k + 1) : Ext P) = shiftReduce (monomialMod k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [monomialMod, monomialMod, Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: toQuot_monomialMod
statement: @[simp] theorem toQuot_monomialMod (k : ℕ) : toQuot (monomialMod k : Ext P) = (rt P) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [monomialMod_zero, toQuot_one, pow_zero]
  | succ n ih => rw [monomialMod_succ, toQuot_shiftReduce, ih, pow_succ']

name: toQuot_mul
statement: @[simp] theorem toQuot_mul (x y : Ext P) : toQuot (x * y) = toQuot x * toQuot y
proof:
:= by
  have hL : toQuot (x * y)
      = ∑ i : Fin P.d, ∑ j : Fin P.d,
          algebraMap F Quot[P] (coeff x i * coeff y j) * (rt P) ^ ((i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ)) := by
    rw [toQuot]
    simp only [coeff_mul, map_sum, map_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [show (∑ m : Fin P.d, algebraMap F Quot[P] (coeff x i) * algebraMap F Quot[P] (coeff y j)
            * algebraMap F Quot[P] (coeff (monomialMod ((i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ))) m) * (rt P) ^ (m : ℕ))
        = algebraMap F Quot[P] (coeff x i) * algebraMap F Quot[P] (coeff y j)
            * ∑ m : Fin P.d, algebraMap F Quot[P] (coeff (monomialMod ((i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ))) m)
                * (rt P) ^ (m : ℕ) from by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => by ring]
    rw [← toQuot, toQuot_monomialMod, ← map_mul]
  rw [hL, toQuot, toQuot, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [map_mul, pow_add]; ring

name: mul_assoc'
statement: theorem mul_assoc' (x y z : Ext P) : x * y * z = x * (y * z)
proof:
:=
  toQuot_injective (by simp only [toQuot_mul, mul_assoc])

name: toQuot_pow
statement: @[simp] theorem toQuot_pow (x : Ext P) (n : ℕ) : toQuot (x ^ n) = toQuot x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  let : Semigroup (Ext P) := { mul_assoc := mul_assoc' }
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pow_def, npowBinRec_zero, toQuot_one, pow_zero]
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_def, npowBinRec_succ, toQuot_mul, ← pow_def, ih, pow_succ]

name: toQuot_ofBase
statement:
@[simp] theorem toQuot_ofBase (c : F) :
    toQuot (ofBase (P := P) c) = algebraMap F Quot[P] c
proof:
:= by
  rw [toQuot, Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem ⟨0, P.d_pos⟩ (Finset.mem_univ _)]
  · simp
  · intro k _ hk
    have : (k : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hk (Fin.ext h)
    simp [this]

name: toQuot_gen
statement: @[simp] theorem toQuot_gen : toQuot (gen : Ext P) = rt P
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 : ℕ) < P.d := P.two_le
  rw [toQuot, Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem ⟨1, h1⟩ (Finset.mem_univ _)]
  · simp
  · intro k _ hk
    have : (k : ℕ) ≠ 1 := fun h => hk (Fin.ext h)
    simp [this]

name: ofBaseRingHom_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem ofBaseRingHom_apply (c : F) : ofBaseRingHom P c = ofBase c
proof: := rfl

name: algebraMap_eq_ofBase
statement: @[simp] theorem algebraMap_eq_ofBase (c : F) : algebraMap F (Ext P) c = ofBase c
proof: := rfl

name: toQuot_sum
statement:
theorem toQuot_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Ext P) :
    toQuot (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, toQuot (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Finset.induction_on s (by simp) ?_
  intro a s ha ih
  rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, toQuot_add, ih]

name: gen_pow_d
statement: theorem gen_pow_d : (gen : Ext P) ^ P.d = monomialMod P.d
proof:
:=
  toQuot_injective (by rw [toQuot_pow, toQuot_gen, toQuot_monomialMod])

name: aeval_gen_poly
statement: theorem aeval_gen_poly : aeval (gen : Ext P) P.poly = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : aeval (gen : Ext P) P.poly
      = gen ^ P.d + ∑ i : Fin P.d, ofBase (P.lowerCoeff i) * gen ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    rw [ExtensionParams.poly, map_add, map_pow, aeval_X, map_sum]
    refine congrArg₂ (· + ·) rfl (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, aeval_X, aeval_C, algebraMap_eq_ofBase]
  rw [hexp]
  apply toQuot_injective
  rw [toQuot_zero, toQuot_add, toQuot_pow, toQuot_gen, toQuot_sum,
    show (∑ i : Fin P.d, toQuot (ofBase (P.lowerCoeff i) * gen ^ (i : ℕ)))
        = ∑ i : Fin P.d, algebraMap F Quot[P] (P.lowerCoeff i) * (rt P) ^ (i : ℕ) from
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by
        rw [toQuot_mul, toQuot_ofBase, toQuot_pow, toQuot_gen]]
  exact rt_relation

name: rt_pow_d_binomial
statement:
theorem rt_pow_d_binomial (P : BinomialParams F) :
    (rt P.toExtensionParams) ^ P.d = algebraMap F Quot[P.toExtensionParams] P.W
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (∑ i : Fin P.toExtensionParams.d,
        algebraMap F Quot[P.toExtensionParams] (P.toExtensionParams.lowerCoeff i)
          * (rt P.toExtensionParams) ^ (i : ℕ))
      = -algebraMap F Quot[P.toExtensionParams] P.W := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem (⟨0, P.d_pos⟩ : Fin P.toExtensionParams.d) (Finset.mem_univ _)]
    · rw [BinomialParams.toExtensionParams_lowerCoeff]; simp
    · intro i _ hi
      have hi0 : (i : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hi (Fin.ext (by simpa using h))
      rw [BinomialParams.toExtensionParams_lowerCoeff, if_neg hi0, map_zero, zero_mul]
  have h := rt_relation (P := P.toExtensionParams)
  rw [hsum, ← sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_zero] at h
  exact h

name: gen_pow_d_binomial
statement:
theorem gen_pow_d_binomial (P : BinomialParams F) :
    (gen : Ext P.toExtensionParams) ^ P.d = ofBase P.W
proof:
:=
  toQuot_injective (by rw [toQuot_pow, toQuot_gen, toQuot_ofBase, rt_pow_d_binomial])

name: lowerCoeffNat_coe
statement: @[simp] theorem lowerCoeffNat_coe (i : Fin P.d) : P.lowerCoeffNat (i : ℕ) = P.lowerCoeff i
proof:
:= by
  rw [lowerCoeffNat, dif_pos i.isLt]; rfl

name: lowerCoeffNat_of_ge
statement: theorem lowerCoeffNat_of_ge {k : ℕ} (h : P.d ≤ k) : P.lowerCoeffNat k = 0
proof: := dif_neg (by omega)

name: d_pos
statement: theorem d_pos : 0 < P.d
proof: := by have := P.two_le; omega

name: degree_lower_lt
statement:
theorem degree_lower_lt :
    (∑ i : Fin P.d, C (P.lowerCoeff i) * X ^ (i : ℕ)).degree < (P.d : WithBot ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_sum_le _ _) ?_
  rw [Finset.sup_lt_iff (by exact_mod_cast WithBot.bot_lt_coe P.d)]
  intro i _
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_C_mul_X_pow_le _ _) (by exact_mod_cast i.isLt)

name: degree_poly
statement: theorem degree_poly : P.poly.degree = (P.d : WithBot ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [poly, degree_add_eq_left_of_degree_lt (by rw [degree_X_pow]; exact P.degree_lower_lt),
    degree_X_pow]

name: monic_poly
statement: theorem monic_poly : P.poly.Monic
proof:
:= by
  rw [poly]
  exact (monic_X_pow P.d).add_of_left (by rw [degree_X_pow]; exact P.degree_lower_lt)

name: natDegree_poly
statement: @[simp] theorem natDegree_poly : P.poly.natDegree = P.d
proof:
:=
  natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some P.degree_poly

name: coeff_ofFn
statement: @[simp] theorem coeff_ofFn (g : Fin P.d → F) (i : Fin P.d) : coeff (ofFn g) i = g i
proof:
:= by
  simp [coeff, ofFn, ofVector, coeffs]

name: ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext {x y : Ext P} (h : ∀ i, coeff x i = coeff y i) : x = y
proof:
:=
  Vector.ext fun i hi => h ⟨i, hi⟩

name: ofFn_coeff
statement: theorem ofFn_coeff (x : Ext P) : ofFn (coeff x) = x
proof: := by ext i; simp

name: coeffNat_coe
statement: @[simp] theorem coeffNat_coe (x : Ext P) (i : Fin P.d) : coeffNat x (i : ℕ) = coeff x i
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeffNat, dif_pos i.isLt]

name: coeffNat_of_lt
statement: theorem coeffNat_of_lt (x : Ext P) {i : ℕ} (h : i < P.d) : coeffNat x i = coeff x ⟨i, h⟩
proof:
:=
  dif_pos h

name: coeffNat_of_ge
statement: theorem coeffNat_of_ge (x : Ext P) {i : ℕ} (h : P.d ≤ i) : coeffNat x i = 0
proof:
:=
  dif_neg (by omega)

name: red_getElem
statement:
@[simp] theorem red_getElem {k : ℕ} (hk : k < 2 * P.d - 1) :
    (red P)[k] = monomialMod k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [red, Vector.getElem_ofFn]

name: mul_eq_mulTbl
statement: @[csimp] theorem mul_eq_mulTbl : @mul = @mulTbl
proof:
:= by
  funext F _ _ P x y
  refine Ext.ext fun m => ?_
  simp only [mul, mulTbl, coeff_ofFn]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [red_getElem]

name: coeff_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem coeff_zero (i : Fin P.d) : coeff (0 : Ext P) i = 0
proof: := coeff_ofFn _ _

name: coeff_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_one (i : Fin P.d) :
    coeff (1 : Ext P) i = if (i : ℕ) = 0 then 1 else 0
proof: := coeff_ofFn _ _

name: coeff_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_add (x y : Ext P) (i : Fin P.d) :
    coeff (x + y) i = coeff x i + coeff y i
proof: := coeff_ofFn _ _

name: coeff_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem coeff_neg (x : Ext P) (i : Fin P.d) : coeff (-x) i = -coeff x i
proof: := coeff_ofFn _ _

name: coeff_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_sub (x y : Ext P) (i : Fin P.d) :
    coeff (x - y) i = coeff x i - coeff y i
proof: := coeff_ofFn _ _

name: coeff_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_smul (c : F) (x : Ext P) (i : Fin P.d) :
    coeff (c • x) i = c * coeff x i
proof: := coeff_ofFn _ _

name: coeff_shiftReduce
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_shiftReduce (e : Ext P) (m : Fin P.d) :
    coeff (shiftReduce e) m =
      (if (m : ℕ) = 0 then 0 else coeffNat e ((m : ℕ) - 1))
        - coeffNat e (P.d - 1) * P.lowerCoeff m
proof: := coeff_ofFn _ _

name: coeff_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_mul (x y : Ext P) (m : Fin P.d) :
    coeff (x * y) m =
      ∑ i : Fin P.d, ∑ j : Fin P.d,
        coeff x i * coeff y j * coeff (monomialMod ((i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ))) m
proof:
:=
  coeff_ofFn _ _

name: coeff_ofBase
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_ofBase (c : F) (i : Fin P.d) :
    coeff (ofBase (P := P) c) i = if (i : ℕ) = 0 then c else 0
proof: := coeff_ofFn _ _

name: coeff_gen
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_gen (i : Fin P.d) :
    coeff (gen : Ext P) i = if (i : ℕ) = 1 then 1 else 0
proof: := coeff_ofFn _ _

name: ofBase_one
statement: @[simp] theorem ofBase_one : ofBase (P := P) (1 : F) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: ofBase_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem ofBase_zero : ofBase (P := P) (0 : F) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i; simp only [coeff_ofBase, coeff_zero, ite_self]

name: ofBase_natCast
statement: @[simp] theorem ofBase_natCast (n : ℕ) : ofBase (P := P) (n : F) = (n : Ext P)
proof: := rfl

name: ofBase_intCast
statement: @[simp] theorem ofBase_intCast (n : ℤ) : ofBase (P := P) (n : F) = (n : Ext P)
proof: := rfl

name: coeff_natCast
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_natCast (n : ℕ) (i : Fin P.d) :
    coeff (n : Ext P) i = if (i : ℕ) = 0 then (n : F) else 0
proof: := coeff_ofFn _ _

name: coeff_intCast
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_intCast (n : ℤ) (i : Fin P.d) :
    coeff (n : Ext P) i = if (i : ℕ) = 0 then (n : F) else 0
proof: := coeff_ofFn _ _

name: pow_def
statement: theorem pow_def (x : Ext P) (n : ℕ) : x ^ n = npowBinRec n x
proof: := rfl

name: d_pos
statement: theorem d_pos : 0 < P.d
proof: := by have := P.two_le; omega

name: natDegree_poly
statement: @[simp] theorem natDegree_poly : P.poly.natDegree = P.d
proof: := natDegree_X_pow_sub_C

name: monic_poly
statement: theorem monic_poly : P.poly.Monic
proof: := monic_X_pow_sub_C _ (by have := P.two_le; omega)

name: toExtensionParams_d
statement: @[simp] theorem toExtensionParams_d : P.toExtensionParams.d = P.d
proof: := rfl

name: toExtensionParams_q
statement: @[simp] theorem toExtensionParams_q : P.toExtensionParams.q = P.q
proof: := rfl

name: toExtensionParams_lowerCoeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem toExtensionParams_lowerCoeff (i : Fin P.toExtensionParams.d) :
    P.toExtensionParams.lowerCoeff i = if (i : ℕ) = 0 then -P.W else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ExtensionParams.lowerCoeff, toExtensionParams, Vector.getElem_ofFn]

name: toExtensionParams_poly
statement: theorem toExtensionParams_poly : P.toExtensionParams.poly = P.poly
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (∑ i : Fin P.toExtensionParams.d,
      C (P.toExtensionParams.lowerCoeff i) * X ^ (i : ℕ)) = -C P.W := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem (⟨0, P.d_pos⟩ : Fin P.toExtensionParams.d) (Finset.mem_univ _)]
    · rw [toExtensionParams_lowerCoeff]; simp
    · intro i _ hi
      have hi0 : (i : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hi (Fin.ext (by simpa using h))
      rw [toExtensionParams_lowerCoeff, if_neg hi0, map_zero, zero_mul]
  rw [ExtensionParams.poly, hsum, poly, ← sub_eq_add_neg, toExtensionParams_d]

name: card_ext
statement: theorem card_ext : Fintype.card (Ext P) = P.q ^ P.d
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_congr (equivFn P), Fintype.card_fun, P.card_eq, Fintype.card_fin]

name: four_le_card_pow
statement: theorem four_le_card_pow : 4 ≤ P.q ^ P.d
proof:
:= by
  have hq : 2 ≤ P.q := by rw [← P.card_eq]; exact Fintype.one_lt_card
  calc (4 : ℕ) = 2 ^ 2 := by norm_num
    _ ≤ 2 ^ P.d := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) P.two_le
    _ ≤ P.q ^ P.d := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hq P.d

name: toQuot_surjective
statement: theorem toQuot_surjective : Function.Surjective (toQuot (P := P))
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := AdjoinRoot.mk_surjective z
  
  have hdeg : (p %ₘ P.poly).natDegree < P.d := by
    rcases eq_or_ne (p %ₘ P.poly) 0 with h0 | h0
    · simpa [h0] using P.d_pos
    · refine (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt h0).mpr ?_
      rw [← degree_poly]
      exact degree_modByMonic_lt p P.monic_poly
  refine ⟨ofFn fun i => (p %ₘ P.poly).coeff (i : ℕ), ?_⟩
  rw [toQuot_eq_mk]
  simp only [coeff_ofFn]
  have hsum : ∑ i : Fin P.d, C ((p %ₘ P.poly).coeff (i : ℕ)) * X ^ (i : ℕ) = p %ₘ P.poly := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => C ((p %ₘ P.poly).coeff i) * X ^ i) P.d]
    exact (as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow' _ hdeg).symm
  rw [hsum]
  refine AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_mk.mpr ⟨-(p /ₘ P.poly), ?_⟩
  linear_combination modByMonic_add_div p P.poly

name: toQuot_bijective
statement: theorem toQuot_bijective : Function.Bijective (toQuot (P := P))
proof:
:=
  ⟨toQuot_injective, toQuot_surjective⟩

name: ringEquivQuot_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem ringEquivQuot_apply (x : Ext P) : ringEquivQuot P x = toQuot x
proof: := rfl

name: card_quot
statement: theorem card_quot : Fintype.card Quot[P] = P.q ^ P.d
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Fintype.card_congr (ringEquivQuot P).toEquiv, card_ext]

name: inv_def
statement: theorem inv_def (x : Ext P) : x⁻¹ = x ^ (P.q ^ P.d - 2)
proof: := rfl

name: div_def
statement: theorem div_def (x y : Ext P) : x / y = x * y⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: inv_zero'
statement: theorem inv_zero' : (0 : Ext P)⁻¹ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h4 := four_le_card_pow (P := P)
  rw [inv_def, zero_pow (by omega)]

name: mul_inv_cancel'
statement: theorem mul_inv_cancel' {x : Ext P} (hx : x ≠ 0) : x * x⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine toQuot_injective ?_
  rw [toQuot_mul, inv_def, toQuot_pow, toQuot_one, ← pow_succ']
  have hz : toQuot x ≠ 0 := fun h => hx (toQuot_injective (by rw [h, toQuot_zero]))
  have h4 := four_le_card_pow (P := P)
  have hexp : P.q ^ P.d - 2 + 1 = Fintype.card Quot[P] - 1 := by
    rw [card_quot]; omega
  rw [hexp]
  exact FiniteField.pow_card_sub_one_eq_one _ hz

name: X_pow_sub_C_dvd_X_pow_mul_sub_C_pow
statement:
theorem X_pow_sub_C_dvd_X_pow_mul_sub_C_pow (W : F) (d k : ℕ) :
    (X ^ d - C W) ∣ X ^ (d * k) - C (W ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_mul, map_pow]
  exact sub_dvd_pow_sub_pow _ _ k

name: X_pow_sub_X_eq
statement:
private theorem X_pow_sub_X_eq {d k N : ℕ} (hN : d * k + 1 = N) :
    (X : F[X]) ^ N - X = X * (X ^ (d * k) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hN]; ring

name: div_eq_of_sub_one_eq
statement:
private theorem div_eq_of_sub_one_eq {d k N : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hk : N - 1 = d * k) :
    (N - 1) / d = k
proof:
:= by
  rw [hk, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left k hd]

name: not_isUnit_X_pow_sub_C
statement:
private theorem not_isUnit_X_pow_sub_C (W : F) {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    ¬ IsUnit ((X : F[X]) ^ d - C W)
proof:
:=
  not_isUnit_of_natDegree_pos _ (by rw [natDegree_X_pow_sub_C]; omega)

name: not_X_dvd_X_pow_sub_C
statement:
theorem not_X_dvd_X_pow_sub_C {W : F} {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hW : W ≠ 0) :
    ¬ (X : F[X]) ∣ X ^ d - C W
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_dvd_iff, coeff_sub, coeff_X_pow, coeff_C_zero, if_neg (by omega), zero_sub, neg_eq_zero]
  exact hW

name: X_pow_sub_C_dvd_X_pow_sub_X
statement:
theorem X_pow_sub_C_dvd_X_pow_sub_X {W : F} {d N : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hdvd : d ∣ N - 1) (hW : W ^ ((N - 1) / d) = 1) :
    (X ^ d - C W) ∣ X ^ N - X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdvd
  rw [div_eq_of_sub_one_eq hd hk] at hW
  rw [X_pow_sub_X_eq (d := d) (k := k) (by omega)]
  refine Dvd.dvd.mul_left ?_ X
  have h := X_pow_sub_C_dvd_X_pow_mul_sub_C_pow W d k
  rwa [hW, map_one] at h

name: isCoprime_X_pow_sub_C_X_pow_sub_X
statement:
theorem isCoprime_X_pow_sub_C_X_pow_sub_X {W : F} {d N : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hW0 : W ≠ 0)
    (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hdvd : d ∣ N - 1) (hW : W ^ ((N - 1) / d) ≠ 1) :
    IsCoprime (X ^ d - C W) (X ^ N - X)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdvd
  rw [div_eq_of_sub_one_eq hd hk] at hW
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := X_pow_sub_C_dvd_X_pow_mul_sub_C_pow W d k
  
  have hsplit : (X : F[X]) ^ N - X = X * C (W ^ k - 1) + (X ^ d - C W) * (X * t) := by
    rw [X_pow_sub_X_eq (d := d) (k := k) (by omega)]
    have hXdk : (X : F[X]) ^ (d * k) = C (W ^ k) + (X ^ d - C W) * t := by rw [← ht]; ring
    rw [hXdk, map_sub, map_one]; ring
  rw [hsplit]
  refine IsCoprime.add_mul_left_right (IsCoprime.mul_right ?_ ?_) (X * t)
  · exact ((irreducible_X.coprime_iff_not_dvd).mpr (not_X_dvd_X_pow_sub_C hd hW0)).symm
  · 
    refine ⟨0, C (W ^ k - 1)⁻¹, ?_⟩
    rw [zero_mul, zero_add, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero_of_ne hW), map_one]

name: eq_one_of_X_pow_sub_C_dvd_X_pow_sub_X
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_X_pow_sub_C_dvd_X_pow_sub_X {W : F} {d N : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hW0 : W ≠ 0)
    (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hdvd : d ∣ N - 1) (h : (X ^ d - C W) ∣ X ^ N - X) :
    W ^ ((N - 1) / d) = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hW
  exact not_isUnit_X_pow_sub_C W hd
    ((isCoprime_X_pow_sub_C_X_pow_sub_X hd hW0 hN hdvd hW).isUnit_of_dvd h)

name: ne_one_of_isCoprime_X_pow_sub_C_X_pow_sub_X
statement:
theorem ne_one_of_isCoprime_X_pow_sub_C_X_pow_sub_X {W : F} {d N : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hdvd : d ∣ N - 1) (h : IsCoprime ((X : F[X]) ^ d - C W) (X ^ N - X)) :
    W ^ ((N - 1) / d) ≠ 1
proof:
:= fun hW =>
  not_isUnit_X_pow_sub_C W hd (h.isUnit_of_dvd (X_pow_sub_C_dvd_X_pow_sub_X hd hN hdvd hW))

name: one_le_card_pow
statement: private theorem one_le_card_pow (n : ℕ) : 1 ≤ Fintype.card F ^ n
proof:
:=
  Nat.one_le_pow _ _ Fintype.card_pos

name: irreducible_X_pow_sub_C_iff
statement:
theorem irreducible_X_pow_sub_C_iff {d : ℕ} {W : F} (hd : 0 < d) (hW0 : W ≠ 0)
    (h_top : d ∣ Fintype.card F ^ d - 1)
    (h_mid : ∀ ℓ ∈ d.primeFactors, d ∣ Fintype.card F ^ (d / ℓ) - 1) :
    Irreducible ((X : F[X]) ^ d - C W) ↔
      (W ^ ((Fintype.card F ^ d - 1) / d) = 1 ∧
        ∀ ℓ ∈ d.primeFactors, W ^ ((Fintype.card F ^ (d / ℓ) - 1) / d) ≠ 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h_deg : ((X : F[X]) ^ d - C W).natDegree = d := natDegree_X_pow_sub_C
  constructor
  · intro h_irr
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := rabin_of_irreducible h_deg hd h_irr
    refine ⟨eq_one_of_X_pow_sub_C_dvd_X_pow_sub_X hd hW0 (one_le_card_pow d) h_top h₁,
      fun ℓ hℓ => ?_⟩
    exact ne_one_of_isCoprime_X_pow_sub_C_X_pow_sub_X hd (one_le_card_pow _) (h_mid ℓ hℓ) (h₂ ℓ hℓ)
  · intro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    refine irreducible_of_rabin h_deg hd
      (X_pow_sub_C_dvd_X_pow_sub_X hd (one_le_card_pow d) h_top h₁) (fun ℓ hℓ => ?_)
    exact isCoprime_X_pow_sub_C_X_pow_sub_X hd hW0 (one_le_card_pow _) (h_mid ℓ hℓ) (h₂ ℓ hℓ)

name: primeFactors_four
statement: private theorem primeFactors_four : (4 : ℕ).primeFactors = {2}
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (4 : ℕ) = 2 ^ 2 from by norm_num,
    Nat.primeFactors_prime_pow (by norm_num) Nat.prime_two]

name: irreducible_X_pow_four_sub_C_iff
statement:
theorem irreducible_X_pow_four_sub_C_iff {W : F} (hW0 : W ≠ 0)
    (h_top : 4 ∣ Fintype.card F ^ 4 - 1)
    (h_mid : 4 ∣ Fintype.card F ^ 2 - 1) :
    Irreducible ((X : F[X]) ^ 4 - C W) ↔
      (W ^ ((Fintype.card F ^ 4 - 1) / 4) = 1 ∧
        W ^ ((Fintype.card F ^ 2 - 1) / 4) ≠ 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hmid' : ∀ ℓ ∈ (4 : ℕ).primeFactors, 4 ∣ Fintype.card F ^ (4 / ℓ) - 1 := by
    simp only [primeFactors_four, Finset.mem_singleton]
    rintro ℓ rfl
    simpa using h_mid
  rw [irreducible_X_pow_sub_C_iff (by norm_num) hW0 h_top hmid']
  simp only [primeFactors_four, Finset.mem_singleton, forall_eq]

name: irreducible_X_pow_four_sub_C
statement:
theorem irreducible_X_pow_four_sub_C {W : F} (hW0 : W ≠ 0)
    (h_top : 4 ∣ Fintype.card F ^ 4 - 1)
    (h_mid : 4 ∣ Fintype.card F ^ 2 - 1)
    (rabin_top : W ^ ((Fintype.card F ^ 4 - 1) / 4) = 1)
    (rabin_mid : W ^ ((Fintype.card F ^ 2 - 1) / 4) ≠ 1) :
    Irreducible ((X : F[X]) ^ 4 - C W)
proof:
:=
  (irreducible_X_pow_four_sub_C_iff hW0 h_top h_mid).mpr ⟨rabin_top, rabin_mid⟩

name: irreducible_X_pow_four_sub_C_of_card
statement:
theorem irreducible_X_pow_four_sub_C_of_card {q : ℕ} {W : F}
    (hcard : Fintype.card F = q) (hW0 : W ≠ 0)
    (h_top : 4 ∣ q ^ 4 - 1) (h_mid : 4 ∣ q ^ 2 - 1)
    (rabin_top : W ^ ((q ^ 4 - 1) / 4) = 1)
    (rabin_mid : W ^ ((q ^ 2 - 1) / 4) ≠ 1) :
    Irreducible ((X : F[X]) ^ 4 - C W)
proof:
:= by
  subst hcard
  exact irreducible_X_pow_four_sub_C hW0 h_top h_mid rabin_top rabin_mid

name: irreducible_X_pow_four_sub_C_iff_of_card
statement:
theorem irreducible_X_pow_four_sub_C_iff_of_card {q : ℕ} {W : F}
    (hcard : Fintype.card F = q) (hW0 : W ≠ 0)
    (h_top : 4 ∣ q ^ 4 - 1) (h_mid : 4 ∣ q ^ 2 - 1) :
    Irreducible ((X : F[X]) ^ 4 - C W) ↔
      (W ^ ((q ^ 4 - 1) / 4) = 1 ∧ W ^ ((q ^ 2 - 1) / 4) ≠ 1)
proof:
:= by
  subst hcard
  exact irreducible_X_pow_four_sub_C_iff hW0 h_top h_mid

name: ScalarField_is_prime
statement: theorem ScalarField_is_prime : Nat.Prime scalarFieldSize
proof:
:= by
  unfold scalarFieldSize
  refine PrattCertificate'.out (p := scalarFieldSize) ⟨22, (by reduce_mod_char), ?_⟩
  refine .split [2 ^ 47, 3, 5, 7, 13, 499, 958612291309063373, 9586122913090633729 ^ 2]
    (fun r hr => ?_) (by norm_num)
  simp at hr
  rcases hr with hr | hr | hr | hr | hr | hr | hr | hr <;> rw [hr]
  · exact .prime 2 47 _ (by pratt) (by reduce_mod_char; decide) (by norm_num)
  · exact .prime 3 1 _ (by pratt) (by reduce_mod_char; decide) (by norm_num)
  · exact .prime 5 1 _ (by pratt) (by reduce_mod_char; decide) (by norm_num)
  · exact .prime 7 1 _ (by pratt) (by reduce_mod_char; decide) (by norm_num)

name: toNat_ofUInt64
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toNat_ofUInt64 (x : UInt64) :
    toNat (ofUInt64 x) = x.toNat % Goldilocks.fieldSize
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have hraw : toNat (ofUInt64 x) = (reduceUInt64Raw x).toNat := rfl
  rw [hraw]
  have hx_two := uint64_toNat_lt_two_fieldSize x
  unfold reduceUInt64Raw
  by_cases hx : x < modulus
  · rw [if_pos hx]
    rw [UInt64.lt_iff_toNat_lt, modulus_toNat] at hx
    exact (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx).symm
  · rw [if_neg hx]
    rw [UInt64.lt_iff_toNat_lt, modulus_toNat] at hx
    have hp : Goldilocks.fieldSize ≤ x.toNat := Nat.le_of_not_gt hx
    have hle : modulus ≤ x := by
      rw [UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le, modulus_toNat]
      exact hp
    
    rw [UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le _ _ hle, modulus_toNat, Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod hp,
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]

name: canonical_inv_eq_pow
statement:
private lemma canonical_inv_eq_pow (a : Goldilocks.Field) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    a⁻¹ = a ^ (Goldilocks.fieldSize - 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : Fintype.card Goldilocks.Field = Goldilocks.fieldSize :=
    ZMod.card Goldilocks.fieldSize
  have h1 : a ^ (Goldilocks.fieldSize - 1) = 1 := by
    have h := FiniteField.pow_card_sub_one_eq_one a ha
    rw [hcard] at h
    exact h
  have hmul : a * a ^ (Goldilocks.fieldSize - 2) = 1 := by
    rw [← pow_succ']
    show a ^ (Goldilocks.fieldSize - 2 + 1) = 1
    have : Goldilocks.fieldSize - 2 + 1 = Goldilocks.fieldSize - 1 := by
      unfold Goldilocks.fieldSize
      omega
    rw [this]
    exact h1
  exact (eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left (by rwa [mul_comm])).symm

name: toField_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toField_add (x y : Field) : toField (x + y) = toField x + toField y
proof:
:= by
  change
    (((add x y).val.toNat : Goldilocks.Field) =
      (x.val.toNat : Goldilocks.Field) + (y.val.toNat : Goldilocks.Field))
  unfold add
  rw [reduceAddWithCarryRaw_cast _ _
    (addWithCarry_bound x.val y.val x.property y.property)]
  let lo := x.val + y.val
  let carry := decide (lo < x.val)
  have hvalue := addWithCarry_value x.val y.val
  change lo.toNat + (if carry then UInt64.size else 0) = x.val.toNat + y.val.toNat at hvalue
  change
    ((lo.toNat : Goldilocks.Field) +
        (if carry then (UInt64.size : Goldilocks.Field) else 0) =
      (x.val.toNat : Goldilocks.Field) + (y.val.toNat : Goldilocks.Field))
  by_cases hcarry : carry = true
  · simp only [hcarry, if_true] at hvalue ⊢
    rw [← Nat.cast_add, hvalue, Nat.cast_add]
  · simp only [hcarry, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, add_zero] at hvalue ⊢
    rw [hvalue, Nat.cast_add]

proof:
:= by
  rw [← UInt64.toNat_toBitVec (x &&& negModulus)]
  rw [UInt64.toBitVec_and]
  rw [BitVec.toNat_and]
