statement:
lemma smul_zero_equiv {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    (smul 0 p) ≈ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h_smul_zero : ∀ (p : CPolynomial.Raw R), (smul 0 p).coeff = 0 := by
    intro p; ext i; simp [smul]
    cases p[i]? <;> simp
  exact fun i => by simpa using congr_fun (h_smul_zero p) i

name: add_equiv
statement:
lemma add_equiv {R : Type*} [Semiring R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    (p1 p2 q1 q2 : CPolynomial.Raw R)
  (hp : equiv p1 p2) (hq : equiv q1 q2) :
  equiv (p1.add q1) (p2.add q2)
proof:
:= by
  have h_add_equiv_raw : ∀ p q : CPolynomial.Raw R, equiv (p.add q) (p.addRaw q) := by
    exact fun p q => add_equiv_raw p q
  have h_add_coeff : ∀ i, (p1.addRaw q1).coeff i = p1.coeff i + q1.coeff i
      ∧ (p2.addRaw q2).coeff i = p2.coeff i + q2.coeff i := by
    exact fun i => ⟨ add_coeff? p1 q1 i, add_coeff? p2 q2 i ⟩
  simp_all [ equiv ]

name: mulPowX_equiv
statement:
lemma mulPowX_equiv {R : Type*} [Zero R]
    (i : ℕ) (p q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (h : equiv p q) :
  equiv (mulPowX i p) (mulPowX i q)
proof:
:= by
  unfold equiv at *
  intro j
  by_cases hj : j < i <;> simp_all +decide [ mulPowX ]
  · unfold mk; rw [ Array.getElem?_append, Array.getElem?_append ]; aesop
  · convert h ( j - i ) using 1 <;> rw [ Array.getElem?_append ] <;> simp +decide [ hj ]
    · rw [ if_neg ( not_lt_of_ge hj ) ]
    · rw [ if_neg ( not_lt_of_ge hj ) ]

name: add_zero_equiv
statement:
lemma add_zero_equiv {R : Type*} [Semiring R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    (p q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (hq : equiv q 0) :
  equiv (add p q) p
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have := add_coeff? p q x
  have hq_zero : q.coeff x = 0 := by exact hq x
  unfold add
  rw [ coeff_eq_coeff ]
  aesop

name: mulPowX_zero_equiv
statement:
lemma mulPowX_zero_equiv {R : Type*} [Zero R]
    (i : ℕ) : equiv (mulPowX i (0 : CPolynomial.Raw R)) 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold equiv
  simp [coeff]
  unfold mulPowX
  grind

name: mulStep_equiv
statement:
lemma mulStep_equiv {R : Type*} [Semiring R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    (q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (acc1 acc2 : CPolynomial.Raw R) (x : R × ℕ)
  (h : equiv acc1 acc2) :
  equiv (mulStep q acc1 x) (mulStep q acc2 x)
proof:
:= by
  apply_rules [ add_equiv, mulPowX_equiv, smul_equiv ]

name: mulStep_zero
statement:
lemma mulStep_zero {R : Type*} [Semiring R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    (q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (acc : CPolynomial.Raw R) (i : ℕ) :
  equiv (mulStep q acc (0, i)) acc
proof:
:= by
  have h_mulStep : mulStep q acc (0, i) = acc.add ((smul 0 q).mulPowX i) := by exact rfl
  have h_mulPowX : mulPowX i (smul 0 q) = smul 0 (mulPowX i q) := by unfold mulPowX smul; aesop
  rw [ h_mulStep, h_mulPowX ]
  exact add_zero_equiv _ _ ( smul_zero_equiv _ )

name: foldl_mulStep_zeros
statement:
lemma foldl_mulStep_zeros {R : Type*} [Semiring R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    (q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (acc : CPolynomial.Raw R) (l : List (R × ℕ))
  (hl : ∀ x ∈ l, x.1 = 0) :
  equiv (l.foldl (mulStep q) acc) acc
proof:
:= by
  induction' l using List.reverseRecOn with x xs ih generalizing acc
  · intro _; rfl
  · simp_all +decide [ List.foldl_append ]
    
    have h_mulStep : equiv (mulStep q (List.foldl (mulStep q) acc x) xs)
        (List.foldl (mulStep q) acc x) := by
      convert mulStep_zero q ( List.foldl ( mulStep q ) acc x ) xs.2 using 1
      specialize hl _ _ ( Or.inr rfl )
      aesop
    exact equiv_trans h_mulStep (ih acc)

name: zipIdx_trim_append
statement:
lemma zipIdx_trim_append {R : Type*} [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    ∃ l, p.zipIdx.toList = p.trim.zipIdx.toList ++ l ∧ ∀ x ∈ l, x.1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h_zipIdx : (p.zipIdx.toList.take p.trim.size) = (p.trim.zipIdx.toList) := by
    have h_trim : p.trim.coeff = p.coeff := by
      ext i; exact (by exact coeff_eq_coeff p i)
    refine' List.ext_get _ _ <;> simp
    · exact size_le_size p
    · intro n hn hn' hn''; have := congr_fun h_trim n; aesop;
  refine' ⟨ List.drop ( Array.size p.trim ) ( Array.zipIdx p |> Array.toList ), _, _ ⟩ <;> simp_all
  · rw [ ← h_zipIdx, List.take_append_drop ];
  · intro a b hab
    have h_trailing : ∀ i ≥ p.trim.size, p.coeff i = 0 := by
      intro i hi
      have h_trailing : p.coeff i = (p.trim).coeff i := by
        exact Eq.symm (coeff_eq_coeff p i)
      grind;
    have h_trailing : ∀ x ∈ List.drop (Array.size p.trim) (Array.zipIdx p |> Array.toList),
        x.1 = p.coeff x.2 := by
      intro x hx
      have h_trailing : ∀ x ∈ List.zipIdx p.toList, x.1 = p.coeff x.2 := by
        simp +decide [ List.mem_iff_get]
        grind
      convert h_trailing x _
      exact List.mem_of_mem_drop hx |> fun h => by simpa using h
    have h_trailing : ∀ x ∈ List.drop (Array.size p.trim) (Array.zipIdx p |> Array.toList),
        x.2 ≥ p.trim.size := by
      intro x hx; have := List.mem_iff_get.mp hx; aesop
    aesop

name: mul_trim_equiv
statement:
lemma mul_trim_equiv [Semiring R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] (a b : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    a.mul b ≈ a.trim.mul b
proof:
:= by
  have h_zipIdx_split : ∃ l, a.zipIdx.toList = a.trim.zipIdx.toList ++ l ∧ ∀ x ∈ l, x.1 = 0 := by
    exact zipIdx_trim_append a
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := h_zipIdx_split
  have h_foldl_split : ∃ acc, (a.mul b) = (l.foldl (mulStep b) acc) ∧ (a.trim.mul b) = acc := by
    
    have h_mul_def : a.mul b = (a.zipIdx.toList.foldl (mulStep b) (mk #[])) :=
      (mul_eq_foldl a b).trans (Array.foldl_toList (mulStep b)).symm
    have h_mul_def_trim : a.trim.mul b = (a.trim.zipIdx.toList.foldl (mulStep b) (mk #[])) :=
      (mul_eq_foldl a.trim b).trans (Array.foldl_toList (mulStep b)).symm
    aesop
  obtain ⟨ acc, h₁, h₂ ⟩ := h_foldl_split
  exact h₁.symm ▸ h₂.symm ▸ foldl_mulStep_zeros b acc l hl.2

name: mul_equiv
statement:
lemma mul_equiv [Semiring R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] (a₁ a₂ b : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    a₁ ≈ a₂ → a₁.mul b ≈ a₂.mul b
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  calc
    a₁.mul b ≈ a₁.trim.mul b := mul_trim_equiv a₁ b
    _ ≈ a₂.trim.mul b := by rw [eq_of_equiv h]
    _ ≈ a₂.mul b := equiv_symm (mul_trim_equiv a₂ b)

name: mul_equiv
statement:
lemma mul_equiv₂ [Semiring R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] (a b₁ b₂ : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    b₁ ≈ b₂ → a.mul b₁ ≈ a.mul b₂
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have h_mul_def : ∀ (a b : CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw R),
    a.mul b = (a.zipIdx.foldl (fun acc ⟨a', i⟩ => acc.add ((smul a' b).mulPowX i)) (mk #[])) :=
      fun a b => mul_eq_foldl a b
  intro h
  have h_foldl_equiv : ∀ (l : List (R × ℕ)) (acc : CompPoly.CPolynomial.Raw R),
    List.foldl (fun acc (a', i) => acc.add ((smul a' b₁).mulPowX i)) acc l ≈
    List.foldl (fun acc (a', i) => acc.add ((smul a' b₂).mulPowX i)) acc l := by
    intro l acc
    induction' l using List.reverseRecOn with l ih generalizing acc; rfl
    · simp +zetaDelta at *
      
      apply add_equiv
      · expose_names; exact h_1 acc
      · 
        apply mulPowX_equiv
        exact fun i => by rw [ smul_equiv, smul_equiv ]; exact congr_arg _ ( h i )
  convert h_foldl_equiv ( Array.toList ( Array.zipIdx a ) ) ( mk #[] ) using 1 <;> grind

name: add_descends
statement:
lemma add_descends [Semiring R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    equiv a₁ a₂ → equiv b₁ b₂ → addDescending a₁ b₁ = addDescending a₂ b₂
proof:
:= by
  intros heq_a heq_b
  unfold addDescending
  apply Quotient.sound
  calc
    add a₁ b₁ ≈ addRaw a₁ b₁ := add_equiv_raw a₁ b₁
    _ ≈ addRaw a₂ b₂ := by
      intro i
      rw [add_coeff? a₁ b₁ i, add_coeff? a₂ b₂ i, heq_a i, heq_b i]
    _ ≈ add a₂ b₂ := equiv_symm (add_equiv_raw a₂ b₂)

name: smul_descends
statement:
lemma smul_descends [Semiring R] (r : R) (p₁ p₂ : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    equiv p₁ p₂ → smulDescending r p₁ = smulDescending r p₂
proof:
:= by
  unfold equiv smulDescending
  intro heq
  apply Quotient.sound
  intro i
  rw [smul_equiv, smul_equiv, heq i]

name: nsmul_descends
statement:
lemma nsmul_descends [Semiring R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] (n : ℕ)
    (p₁ p₂ : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    equiv p₁ p₂ → nsmulDescending n p₁ = nsmulDescending n p₂
proof:
:= by
  unfold equiv
  intro heq
  unfold nsmulDescending
  apply Quotient.sound
  unfold nsmul
  show equiv _ _
  intro i
  repeat rw [nsmulRaw_equiv, coeff_eq_coeff]
  rw [heq i]

name: neg_descends
statement:
lemma neg_descends [NegZeroClass R] (a b : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    equiv a b → negDescending a = negDescending b
proof:
:= by
  unfold equiv negDescending
  intros heq
  apply Quotient.sound
  show equiv _ _
  intro i
  rw [neg_coeff a i, neg_coeff b i, heq i]

name: sub_descends
statement:
lemma sub_descends [Ring R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    equiv a₁ a₂ → equiv b₁ b₂ → subDescending a₁ b₁ = subDescending a₂ b₂
proof:
:= by
  unfold equiv subDescending
  intros heq_a heq_b
  apply Quotient.sound
  unfold sub
  calc
    a₁.add b₁.neg ≈ a₁.addRaw b₁.neg := add_equiv_raw a₁ b₁.neg
    _ ≈ a₂.addRaw b₂.neg := by
      intro i
      rw [add_coeff? a₁ b₁.neg i, add_coeff? a₂ b₂.neg i]
      rw [neg_coeff b₁ i, neg_coeff b₂ i, heq_a i, heq_b i]
    _ ≈ a₂.add b₂.neg := equiv_symm (add_equiv_raw a₂ b₂.neg)

name: mulPowX_descends
statement:
lemma mulPowX_descends [Zero R] (i : ℕ) (p₁ p₂ : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    equiv p₁ p₂ → mulPowXDescending i p₁ = mulPowXDescending i p₂
proof:
:= by
  unfold mulPowXDescending
  intro heq
  apply Quotient.sound
  exact mulPowX_equiv i p₁ p₂ heq

name: mul_descends
statement:
lemma mul_descends [Semiring R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    equiv a₁ a₂ → equiv b₁ b₂ → mulDescending a₁ b₁ = mulDescending a₂ b₂
proof:
:= by
  unfold mulDescending
  intros heq_a heq_b
  apply Quotient.sound
  calc
    a₁.mul b₁ ≈ a₂.mul b₁ := mul_equiv a₁ a₂ b₁ heq_a
    _ ≈ a₂.mul b₂ := mul_equiv₂ a₂ b₁ b₂ heq_b

name: pow_descends
statement:
lemma pow_descends [Semiring R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] (n : ℕ) (p₁ p₂ : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    equiv p₁ p₂ → powDescending p₁ n = powDescending p₂ n
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  unfold powDescending
  apply Quotient.sound
  unfold pow
  have mul_pow_succ_equiv (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) (n : ℕ):
    p.mul^[n + 1] (C 1) ≈ p.mul (p.mul^[n] (C 1)) := by
    rw [mul_pow_succ]
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    calc
      p₁.mul^[n + 1] (C 1) ≈ p₁.mul (p₁.mul^[n] (C 1)) := mul_pow_succ_equiv p₁ n
      _ ≈ p₁.mul (p₂.mul^[n] (C 1)) := mul_equiv₂ p₁ _ _ ih
      _ ≈ p₂.mul (p₂.mul^[n] (C 1)) := mul_equiv _ _ (p₂.mul^[n] (C 1)) heq
      _ ≈ p₂.mul^[n + 1] (C 1) := equiv_symm (mul_pow_succ_equiv p₂ n)

name: add_assoc
statement:
@[grind =_]
lemma add_assoc : ∀ (a b c : QuotientCPolynomial R), a + b + c = a + (b + c)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c
  refine Quotient.inductionOn₃ a b c ?_
  intro p q r; clear a b c
  apply Quotient.sound
  apply eq_to_equiv
  apply CPolynomial.Raw.add_assoc

name: zero_add_equiv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma zero_add_equiv (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) : 0 + p ≈ p
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  change ((0 : CPolynomial.Raw R).add p).coeff i = p.coeff i
  unfold CPolynomial.Raw.add
  rw [Trim.coeff_eq_coeff]
  rw [add_coeff?]
  simp

name: zero_add
statement:
@[simp]
lemma zero_add : ∀ (a : QuotientCPolynomial R), 0 + a = a
proof:
:= by
  intros a
  refine Quotient.inductionOn a ?_
  intro p; clear a
  apply Quotient.sound
  apply zero_add_equiv

name: add_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma add_zero : ∀ (a : QuotientCPolynomial R), a + 0 = a
proof:
:= by
  intros a
  refine Quotient.inductionOn a ?_
  intro p; clear a
  apply Quotient.sound
  intro i
  unfold CPolynomial.Raw.add
  rw [Trim.coeff_eq_coeff]
  rw [add_coeff?]
  simp

name: add_comm
statement:
@[grind =>]
lemma add_comm : ∀ (a b : QuotientCPolynomial R), a + b = b + a
proof:
:= by

  refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ a b ?_
  intros p q; clear a b

  apply eq_to_equiv
  apply CPolynomial.Raw.add_comm

name: nsmul_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma nsmul_zero : ∀ (x : QuotientCPolynomial R),
    QuotientCPolynomial.nsmul 0 x = 0
proof:
:= by

  apply CPolynomial.Raw.nsmul_zero

name: nsmul_succ
statement:
@[grind =>]
lemma nsmul_succ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : QuotientCPolynomial R),

proof:
:= by

  refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
  intro p; clear x
  apply Quotient.sound
  apply eq_to_equiv
  apply CPolynomial.Raw.nsmul_succ

name: neg_add_cancel
statement:
@[simp]
lemma neg_add_cancel : ∀ (a : QuotientCPolynomial R), -a + a = 0

name: sub_eq_add_neg
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma sub_eq_add_neg : ∀ (a b : QuotientCPolynomial R), a - b = a + -b
proof:

  intros p q; clear a b

name: mul_assoc
statement:
lemma mul_assoc (a b c : QuotientCPolynomial R) :
    a * b * c = a * (b * c)
proof:

  intro p q r

  exact mul_assoc_equiv p q r

name: one_mul
statement: lemma one_mul : ∀ (a : QuotientCPolynomial R), 1 * a = a
proof:
:= by
  intros a
  refine Quotient.inductionOn a ?_
  intro p; clear a
  apply Quotient.sound
  change 1 * p ≈ p
  rw [one_mul_trim]
  apply trim_equiv

name: mul_one
statement: lemma mul_one : ∀ (a : QuotientCPolynomial R), a * 1 = a
proof:
:= by
  intros a
  refine Quotient.inductionOn a ?_
  intro p; clear a
  apply Quotient.sound

proof:

name: mul_add
statement:
lemma mul_add : ∀ (a b c : QuotientCPolynomial R),
    a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c
  refine Quotient.inductionOn₃ a b c ?_
  intro p q r
  apply Quotient.sound
  change p * (q + r) ≈ (p * q) + (p * r)
  rw [CPolynomial.Raw.mul_add p q r]

name: add_mul
statement: lemma add_mul : ∀ (a b c : QuotientCPolynomial R), (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c
  refine Quotient.inductionOn₃ a b c ?_
  intro p q r; clear a b c
  apply Quotient.sound
  change (p + q) * r ≈ (p * r) + (q * r)
  rw [CPolynomial.Raw.add_mul]

name: npow_zero
statement: lemma npow_zero : ∀ (x : QuotientCPolynomial R), x.pow 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  intros x
  refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
  intro p; clear x
  apply Quotient.sound
  unfold CPolynomial.Raw.pow
  simp

name: const_sum
statement: lemma const_sum (r s : R) : (C r).add (C s) ≈ C (r + s)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ((C r).addRaw (C s)).trim ≈ ((C r).addRaw (C s)) := by apply trim_equiv
    _ ≈ C (r + s) := by
      unfold C addRaw; simp

name: pow_succ_left
statement:
lemma pow_succ_left (n : ℕ) (x : QuotientCPolynomial R) :
    x.pow (n + 1) = x * x.pow n
proof:
:= by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
  intro p
  apply Quotient.sound
  
  
  have h_pow : p.pow (n + 1) = p.mul (p.pow n) := by
    exact Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _
  exact congrFun (congrArg coeff h_pow)

name: commute_pow_self
statement:
lemma commute_pow_self (n : ℕ) (x : QuotientCPolynomial R) :
    x * x.pow n = x.pow n * x
proof:
:= by
  induction' n with n ih generalizing x
  all_goals generalize_proofs at *
  · rw [show x.pow 0 = 1 from _]
    · simp +decide [mul_one, one_mul]
    · exact npow_zero x
  · rw [ pow_succ_left, mul_assoc, ih, ← mul_assoc ]

name: npow_succ
statement: lemma npow_succ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : QuotientCPolynomial R), x.pow (n + 1) = x.pow n * x
proof:
:= by
  intro n x
  refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
  intro p; clear x
  apply Quotient.sound
  
  rw [show p.pow (n + 1) = p.mul (p.pow n) from by
        exact Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _]
  convert commute_pow_self n ( Quotient.mk ( Raw.instSetoidCPolynomial ) p ) using 1
  erw [ Quotient.eq ]

name: mul_comm
statement: lemma mul_comm : ∀ (a b : QuotientCPolynomial R), a * b = b * a
proof:
:= by
  intro a b
  refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ a b ?_
  intros p q; clear a b
  apply Quotient.sound
  change p * q ≈ q * p
  simp [CPolynomial.Raw.mul_comm p q]

name: toPoly_resp
statement:
theorem toPoly_resp (p q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (h : p ≈ q) :
    p.toPoly = q.toPoly
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [Raw.coeff_toPoly, Raw.coeff_toPoly]
  exact h n

name: toPoly_ofPoly
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toPoly_ofPoly (p : Polynomial R) : toPoly (ofPoly p) = p
proof:
:= by
  simp [toPoly, ofPoly, Raw.toPoly_toImpl]

name: ofPoly_toPoly
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofPoly_toPoly [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] (q : QuotientCPolynomial R) :
    ofPoly (toPoly q) = q
proof:
:= by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
  intro p
  simp only [toPoly, ofPoly, Quotient.lift_mk]
  apply Quotient.sound
  show Trim.equiv (Polynomial.toImpl (Raw.toPoly p)) p
  intro i
  have h₁ : (Polynomial.toImpl (Raw.toPoly p)) = p.trim := Raw.toImpl_toPoly p
  rw [h₁, Trim.coeff_eq_coeff]

name: le_foldl_max_size
statement:
private lemma le_foldl_max_size [Zero R] (polys : List (CPolynomial R)) (acc : Nat) :
    acc ≤ polys.foldl (fun acc p ↦ Nat.max acc p.size) acc
proof:
:= by
  induction polys generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p polys ih =>
      exact (Nat.le_max_left acc p.size).trans (ih (Nat.max acc p.size))

name: size_le_foldl_max_size_of_mem
statement:
private lemma size_le_foldl_max_size_of_mem [Zero R]
    (polys : List (CPolynomial R)) (acc : Nat) {p : CPolynomial R} (hp : p ∈ polys) :
    p.size ≤ polys.foldl (fun acc p ↦ Nat.max acc p.size) acc
proof:
:= by
  induction polys generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp at hp
  | cons q polys ih =>
      simp only [List.mem_cons] at hp
      simp only [List.foldl_cons]
      rcases hp with hp | hp
      · subst p
        exact (Nat.le_max_right acc q.size).trans
          (le_foldl_max_size polys (Nat.max acc q.size))
      · exact ih (Nat.max acc q.size) hp

name: size_le_maxCoeffSize_of_mem
statement:
private lemma size_le_maxCoeffSize_of_mem [Zero R]
    (polys : Array (CPolynomial R)) {p : CPolynomial R} (hp : p ∈ polys.toList) :
    p.size ≤ ManyEval.maxCoeffSize polys
proof:
:= by
  cases polys with
  | mk ps =>
      simpa [ManyEval.maxCoeffSize] using
        size_le_foldl_max_size_of_mem (R := R) ps 0 hp

name: foldl_push_size
statement:
private theorem foldl_push_size [Mul R] (x : R) :
    ∀ xs : List Nat, ∀ (powers : Array R) (pow : R),
      (List.foldl (fun (b : Array R × R) (_ : Nat) ↦ (b.1.push b.2, b.2 * x))
        (powers, pow) xs).1.size = powers.size + xs.length
  | [], powers, _ => by simp
  | _ :: xs, powers, pow => by
      simp [foldl_push_size x xs (powers.push pow) (pow * x), Nat.add_comm,
        Nat.add_left_comm]

private theorem foldl_push_getD [Semiring R] (x : R) :
    ∀ xs : List Nat, ∀ (powers : Array R) (pow base : R) (offset : Nat),
      powers.size = offset →
      (∀ i, i < offset → powers.getD i 0 = base * x ^ i) →
      pow = base * x ^ offset →
      ∀ i, i < offset + xs.length →
        (List.foldl (fun (b : Array R × R) (_ : Nat) ↦ (b.1.push b.2, b.2 * x))
          (powers, pow) xs).1.getD i 0 = base * x ^ i
  | [], powers, _pow, _base, _offset, _hsize, hvals, _hpow, i, hi => by
      exact hvals i (by simpa using hi)
  | _ :: xs, powers, pow, base, offset, hsize, hvals, hpow, i, hi => by
      apply foldl_push_getD x xs (powers.push pow) (pow * x) base (offset + 1)
      · simp [hsize]
      · intro k hk
        by_cases hk0 : k < offset
        · have hkSize : k < powers.size
proof:
:= by simpa [hsize] using hk0
          rw [← hvals k hk0]
          simp [Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?, Array.getElem?_push_lt hkSize,
            Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hkSize]
        · have hkEq : k = offset := by omega
          subst hkEq
          rw [Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?]
          rw [← hsize, Array.getElem?_push_size]
          simpa [hsize] using hpow
      · rw [hpow]
        rw [pow_succ]
        exact _root_.mul_assoc base (x ^ offset) x
      · simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using hi

name: foldl_push_getD
statement:
private theorem foldl_push_getD [Semiring R] (x : R) :
    ∀ xs : List Nat, ∀ (powers : Array R) (pow base : R) (offset : Nat),
      powers.size = offset →
      (∀ i, i < offset → powers.getD i 0 = base * x ^ i) →
      pow = base * x ^ offset →
      ∀ i, i < offset + xs.length →
        (List.foldl (fun (b : Array R × R) (_ : Nat) ↦ (b.1.push b.2, b.2 * x))
          (powers, pow) xs).1.getD i 0 = base * x ^ i
  | [], powers, _pow, _base, _offset, _hsize, hvals, _hpow, i, hi => by
      exact hvals i (by simpa using hi)
  | _ :: xs, powers, pow, base, offset, hsize, hvals, hpow, i, hi => by
      apply foldl_push_getD x xs (powers.push pow) (pow * x) base (offset + 1)
      · simp [hsize]
      · intro k hk
        by_cases hk0 : k < offset
        · have hkSize : k < powers.size
proof:
:= by simpa [hsize] using hk0
          rw [← hvals k hk0]
          simp [Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?, Array.getElem?_push_lt hkSize,
            Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hkSize]
        · have hkEq : k = offset := by omega
          subst hkEq
          rw [Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?]
          rw [← hsize, Array.getElem?_push_size]
          simpa [hsize] using hpow
      · rw [hpow]
        rw [pow_succ]
        exact _root_.mul_assoc base (x ^ offset) x
      · simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using hi

name: powerTableLoop_eq_foldl
statement:
private lemma powerTableLoop_eq_foldl [Mul R] (x : R) (limit i : Nat) (pow : R)
    (acc : Array R) :
    ManyEval.powerTableLoop x limit i pow acc =
      (List.foldl (fun (b : Array R × R) (_ : Nat) ↦ (b.1.push b.2, b.2 * x))
        (acc, pow) (List.range' i (limit - i))).1
proof:
:= by
  fun_induction ManyEval.powerTableLoop x limit i pow acc with
  | case1 i pow acc h ih =>
      rw [ih]
      have hsub : limit - i = (limit - (i + 1)) + 1 := by omega
      simp [hsub, List.range'_succ]
  | case2 i pow acc h =>
      have hsub : limit - i = 0 := by omega
      simp [hsub]

name: powerTable_size
statement:
private lemma powerTable_size [Semiring R] (x : R) (limit : Nat) :
    (ManyEval.powerTable x limit).size = limit
proof:
:= by
  unfold ManyEval.powerTable
  rw [powerTableLoop_eq_foldl]
  simpa using foldl_push_size x (List.range' 0 limit) (#[] : Array R) (1 : R)

name: powerTable_getD_eq_pow
proof:
:= by
  unfold ManyEval.powerTable
  rw [powerTableLoop_eq_foldl]
  have h := foldl_push_getD x (List.range' 0 limit) (#[] : Array R) (1 : R) (1 : R) 0
    (by simp) (by intro i hi; omega) (by simp) i (by simpa using hi)
  simpa using h

name: evalWithPowersLoop_eq_foldl_range
statement:
private lemma evalWithPowersLoop_eq_foldl_range [Semiring R]
    (coeffs powers : Array R) (limit : Nat) (hcoeffs : limit ≤ coeffs.size)
    (hpowers : limit ≤ powers.size) (i : Nat) (acc : R) :
    ManyEval.evalWithPowersLoop coeffs powers limit hcoeffs hpowers i acc =
      List.foldl (fun acc j ↦ acc + coeffs.getD j 0 * powers.getD j 0) acc
        (List.range' i (limit - i))
proof:
:= by
  fun_induction ManyEval.evalWithPowersLoop coeffs powers limit hcoeffs hpowers i acc with
  | case1 i acc h coeff pow ih =>
      subst coeff
      subst pow
      rw [ih]
      have hsub : limit - i = (limit - (i + 1)) + 1 := by omega
      rw [hsub, List.range'_succ]
      have hci : coeffs[i] = coeffs.getD i 0 := by
        simp [Array.getD]
        omega
      have hpi : powers[i] = powers.getD i 0 := by
        simp [Array.getD]
        omega
      simp [List.foldl_cons, hci, hpi]
  | case2 i acc h =>
      have hsub : limit - i = 0 := by omega
      simp [hsub]

name: foldl_zipIdx_eq_range'_getD_aux
statement:
private lemma foldl_zipIdx_eq_range'_getD_aux [Semiring R]
    (xs : List R) (x acc : R) (offset : Nat) :
    List.foldl (fun acc ai ↦ acc + ai.1 * x ^ ai.2) acc (xs.zipIdx offset) =
      List.foldl (fun acc i ↦ acc + xs.getD (i - offset) 0 * x ^ i) acc
        (List.range' offset xs.length)
proof:
:= by
  induction xs generalizing offset acc with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a xs ih =>
      simp only [List.zipIdx_cons, List.foldl_cons, List.length_cons]
      rw [List.range'_succ, List.foldl_cons]
      simp only [Nat.sub_self, List.getD_cons_zero]
      rw [ih]
      apply List.foldl_congr_of_mem
      intro _acc' j hj
      have hsub : j - offset = (j - (offset + 1)) + 1 := by
        have hjmem := List.mem_range'.mp hj
        omega
      simp [hsub]

name: array_getD_toList
statement:
private lemma array_getD_toList {α : Type*} (a : Array α) (i : Nat) (d : α) :
    a.getD i d = a.toList.getD i d
proof:
:= by
  cases a
  simp

name: evalWithPowers_eq_eval
statement:
private lemma evalWithPowers_eq_eval [Semiring R] (coeffs powers : Array R) (x : R)
    (hsize : coeffs.size ≤ powers.size)
    (hpowers : ∀ i, i < coeffs.size → powers.getD i 0 = x ^ i) :
    ManyEval.evalWithPowers coeffs powers =
      coeffs.zipIdx.foldl (fun acc ai ↦ acc + ai.1 * x ^ ai.2) 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [ManyEval.evalWithPowers, Nat.min_eq_left hsize]
  rw [evalWithPowersLoop_eq_foldl_range]
  rw [Array.foldl_zipIdx_eq_foldl_toList_zipIdx_size]
  rw [foldl_zipIdx_eq_range'_getD_aux]
  apply List.foldl_congr_of_mem
  intro _acc' i hi
  rw [← array_getD_toList]
  rw [hpowers i]
  · simp
  · rcases List.mem_range'.mp hi with ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    simpa using hj

name: evalManyWithPowersLoop_toList
statement:
private lemma evalManyWithPowersLoop_toList [Semiring R]
    (polys : Array (CPolynomial R)) (powers : Array R) (i : Nat) (acc : Array R) :
    (ManyEval.evalManyWithPowersLoop polys powers i acc).toList =
      acc.toList ++ (polys.toList.drop i).map
        (fun p ↦ ManyEval.evalWithPowers p.val powers)
proof:
:= by
  fun_induction ManyEval.evalManyWithPowersLoop polys powers i acc with
  | case1 i acc h p ih =>
      rw [ih]
      have hdrop :
          (polys.toList.drop i).map (fun p ↦ ManyEval.evalWithPowers p.val powers) =
            ManyEval.evalWithPowers p.val powers ::
              (polys.toList.drop (i + 1)).map
                (fun p ↦ ManyEval.evalWithPowers p.val powers) := by
        have hiList : i < polys.toList.length := by
          simpa using h
        rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hiList]
        have hget : polys.toList[i] = p := by
          cases polys
          rfl
        simp [hget]
      simp [Array.toList_push, hdrop, List.append_assoc]
  | case2 i acc h =>
      rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le]
      · simp
      · simpa using Nat.le_of_not_gt h

name: evalManyHorner_eq_map_eval
statement:
theorem evalManyHorner_eq_map_eval [Semiring R]
    (polys : Array (CPolynomial R)) (x : R) :
    evalManyHorner polys x = polys.map (fun p ↦ p.eval x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [evalManyHorner, eval_horner_eq_eval]

name: evalManySharedPowers_eq_map_eval
statement:
theorem evalManySharedPowers_eq_map_eval [Semiring R]
    (polys : Array (CPolynomial R)) (x : R) :
    evalManySharedPowers polys x = polys.map (fun p ↦ p.eval x)
proof:
:= by
  apply Array.toList_inj.mp
  simp only [evalManySharedPowers, evalManyWithPowersLoop_toList, Array.toList_map,
    List.drop_zero, List.nil_append]
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro p hp
  simp only [eval]
  apply evalWithPowers_eq_eval
  · rw [powerTable_size]
    simpa [size] using size_le_maxCoeffSize_of_mem polys hp
  · intro i hi
    apply powerTable_getD_eq_pow
    exact hi.trans_le (by simpa [size] using size_le_maxCoeffSize_of_mem polys hp)

name: nttDomainToRS_n
statement:
@[simp] lemma nttDomainToRS_n (D : CPolynomial.NTT.Domain F) :
    (nttDomainToRS D).n = D.n
proof:
:= by
  simp [nttDomainToRS, ReedSolomon.Domain.n]

name: forwardImpl_eq_encode
statement:
theorem forwardImpl_eq_encode (D : CPolynomial.NTT.Domain F) {k : ℕ} (msg : Vector F k)
    (hk : k ≤ D.n) :
    Forward.forwardImpl D (messagePoly msg).val
      = (encode (nttDomainToRS D) msg).toArray
proof:
:= by
  have hdeg : (messagePoly msg).toPoly.natDegree < D.n := by
    by_cases h0 : (messagePoly msg).toPoly = 0
    · simp [h0, Nat.two_pow_pos D.logN]
    · have h1 : (messagePoly msg).toPoly.degree < (k : WithBot ℕ) := by
        rw [← CPolynomial.degree_toPoly]
        exact_mod_cast messagePoly_degree_lt msg
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le ((Polynomial.natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt h0).mpr h1) hk
  rw [Forward.forwardImpl_eq_evalOnDomain D _ hdeg]
  simp only [evalOnDomain, encode, nttDomainToRS, Array.map_ofFn]
  rfl

name: nttCodeword_eq_encode
statement:
theorem nttCodeword_eq_encode (D : CPolynomial.NTT.Domain F) {k : ℕ} (msg : Vector F k)
    (hk : k ≤ D.n) : nttCodeword D msg hk = encode (nttDomainToRS D) msg
proof:
:= by
  apply Vector.toArray_inj.mp
  simpa [nttCodeword] using forwardImpl_eq_encode D msg hk

name: degree_mul_lt_of_bounds
statement:
private lemma degree_mul_lt_of_bounds [Semiring F] [NoZeroDivisors F]
    {A B g₀ : F[X]} (hg₀ : g₀ ≠ 0) (d₀ : ℕ)
    (hA : A.degree + d₀ ≤ g₀.degree) (hB : B.degree < d₀) :
    (A * B).degree < g₀.degree
proof:
:= by
  rw [degree_mul]
  obtain rfl | hA0 := eq_or_ne A 0
  · simp only [Polynomial.degree_zero, WithBot.bot_add, bot_lt_iff_ne_bot, ne_eq, degree_eq_bot,
      hg₀, not_false_eq_true]
  · exact (WithBot.add_lt_add_left
      (by simp only [ne_eq, degree_eq_bot, hA0, not_false_eq_true]) hB).trans_le hA

name: bezout_solutions_cross_mul
statement:
theorem bezout_solutions_cross_mul [CommRing F] [NoZeroDivisors F]
    (g₀ g₁ G U V G' U' V' : F[X]) (d₀ : ℕ) (hg₀ : g₀ ≠ 0)
    (hBez : U * g₀ + V * g₁ = G) (hBez' : U' * g₀ + V' * g₁ = G')
    (hG : G.degree < d₀) (hG' : G'.degree < d₀)
    (hV : V.degree + d₀ ≤ g₀.degree) (hV' : V'.degree + d₀ ≤ g₀.degree) :
    V * G' = V' * G
proof:
:= by
  have hcross : V' * G - V * G' = (V' * U - V * U') * g₀ := by rw [← hBez, ← hBez']; ring
  have hlt : (V' * G - V * G').degree < g₀.degree :=
    (Polynomial.degree_sub_le _ _).trans_lt (max_lt (degree_mul_lt_of_bounds hg₀ _ hV' hG)
      (degree_mul_lt_of_bounds hg₀ _ hV hG'))
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp (eq_zero_of_dvd_of_degree_lt ⟨_, hcross.trans (mul_comm _ _)⟩ hlt)).symm

name: disagreement_subset_error_locator_zeros
statement:
lemma disagreement_subset_error_locator_zeros [CommRing F] [NoZeroDivisors F]
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq F] (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → F) (g₀ g₁ U V f₁ : F[X])
    (hroot : ∀ i ∈ s, g₀.eval (a i) = 0) (hlocator : V * (f₁ - g₁) = U * g₀) :
    {i ∈ s | f₁.eval (a i) ≠ g₁.eval (a i)} ⊆ {i ∈ s | V.eval (a i) = 0}
proof:
:=
  Finset.monotone_filter_right _ fun i hi hne => by
    have hev := congrArg (Polynomial.eval (a i)) hlocator
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_sub, hroot i hi, mul_zero, mul_eq_zero,
      sub_eq_zero] at hev
    exact hev.resolve_right hne

name: disagreement_card_le_error_locator_natDegree
statement:
lemma disagreement_card_le_error_locator_natDegree [CommRing F] [IsDomain F]
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq F] (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → F) (hinj : Set.InjOn a s)
    (g₀ g₁ G U V f₁ : F[X]) (hroot : ∀ i ∈ s, g₀.eval (a i) = 0)
    (hbez : G = U * g₀ + V * g₁) (hsucc : G = f₁ * V) (hV : V ≠ 0) :
    {i ∈ s | f₁.eval (a i) ≠ g₁.eval (a i)}.card ≤ V.natDegree
proof:
:=
  (Finset.card_le_card (disagreement_subset_error_locator_zeros s a _ _ U _ _ hroot
    (by rw [mul_sub, mul_comm V f₁, ← hsucc, hbez]; ring))).trans
    (card_eval_zero_le_natDegree s a hinj _ hV)

name: hammingDist_le_error_locator_natDegree
statement:
lemma hammingDist_le_error_locator_natDegree [CommRing F] [IsDomain F]
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq F] (a : ι → F)
    (hinj : Function.Injective a)
    (g₀ g₁ G U V f₁ : F[X]) (b : ι → F)
    (hroot : ∀ i, g₀.eval (a i) = 0) (hb : ∀ i, g₁.eval (a i) = b i)
    (hbez : G = U * g₀ + V * g₁) (hsucc : G = f₁ * V) (hV : V ≠ 0) :
    hammingDist b (fun i => f₁.eval (a i)) ≤ V.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl : b = fun i => g₁.eval (a i) := funext fun i => (hb i).symm; rw [hammingDist_comm]
  exact disagreement_card_le_error_locator_natDegree Finset.univ a hinj.injOn _ _ _ _ _ _
    (fun i _ => hroot i) hbez hsucc hV

name: receivedInterpolant_eval_node
statement:
lemma receivedInterpolant_eval_node [Field F] (D : Domain F) (r : Vector F D.n) (i : Fin D.n) :
    (receivedInterpolant D r).toPoly.eval (D.val[i]) = r.get i
proof:
:= by
  rw [receivedInterpolant, CLagrange.cinterpolate_eq_interpolate]
  exact Lagrange.eval_interpolate_at_node _ D.node_injective.injOn (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: receivedInterpolant_degree_lt
statement:
lemma receivedInterpolant_degree_lt [Field F] (D : Domain F) (r : Vector F D.n) :
    (receivedInterpolant D r).toPoly.degree < D.n
proof:
:= by
  rw [receivedInterpolant, CLagrange.cinterpolate_eq_interpolate]
  simpa using Lagrange.degree_interpolate_lt (s := .univ) r.get D.node_injective.injOn

name: toPoly_nodalPoly
statement:
lemma toPoly_nodalPoly [CommRing F] [Nontrivial F] (D : Domain F) :
    (nodalPoly D).toPoly = ∏ i : Fin D.n, (X - C (D.val[i]))
proof:
:= by
  rw [nodalPoly, ← Array.foldl_toList,
    ← List.foldl_map (f := fun a => CPolynomial.X - CPolynomial.C a) (g := (· * ·)),
    ← List.prod_eq_foldl, ← List.ofFn_getElem (xs := D.val.toList), List.map_ofFn,
    List.prod_ofFn, toPoly_prod]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, toPoly_sub, X_toPoly, C_toPoly]; rfl

name: natDegree_nodalPoly
statement:
lemma natDegree_nodalPoly [CommRing F] [NoZeroDivisors F] [Nontrivial F] (D : Domain F) :
    (nodalPoly D).toPoly.natDegree = D.n
proof:
:= by
  rw [toPoly_nodalPoly, Polynomial.natDegree_prod _ _ (fun i _ => X_sub_C_ne_zero _)]
  simp only [Fin.getElem_fin, natDegree_sub_C, natDegree_X, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: toPoly_nodalPoly_ne_zero
statement:
lemma toPoly_nodalPoly_ne_zero [CommRing F] [Nontrivial F] (D : Domain F) :
    (nodalPoly D).toPoly ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [toPoly_nodalPoly]; exact (monic_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun i _ => monic_X_sub_C _)).ne_zero

name: degree_nodalPoly
statement:
lemma degree_nodalPoly [CommRing F] [NoZeroDivisors F] [Nontrivial F] (D : Domain F) :
    (nodalPoly D).toPoly.degree = D.n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree (toPoly_nodalPoly_ne_zero D), natDegree_nodalPoly]

name: nodalPoly_eval_node_eq_zero
statement:
lemma nodalPoly_eval_node_eq_zero [CommRing F] [Nontrivial F] (D : Domain F) (i : Fin D.n) :
    (nodalPoly D).toPoly.eval (D.val[i]) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [toPoly_nodalPoly, Polynomial.eval_prod]
  exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i)
    (by simp only [Fin.getElem_fin, Polynomial.eval_sub, eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, sub_self])

name: partialGcd_stopSpec
statement:
lemma partialGcd_stopSpec [Field F] (k : ℕ) (D : Domain F) (r : Vector F D.n) (hkn : k < D.n) :
    BezoutStopSpecOf (nodalPoly D) (receivedInterpolant D r) ((D.n + k + 1) / 2)
      (partialGcd k D r)
proof:
:=
  xgcd_stopSpec _ _ _
    (by simpa only [degree_toPoly, degree_nodalPoly] using receivedInterpolant_degree_lt D r)
    (by omega) (by rw [degree_toPoly, degree_nodalPoly, Nat.cast_le]; omega)

name: decode_sound_aux
statement:
private lemma decode_sound_aux [Field F]
    (k : ℕ) (D : Domain F) (r : Vector F D.n)
    (U G V f₁ : CPolynomial F)
    (hbez : G = U * nodalPoly D + V * receivedInterpolant D r)
    (hVne0 : V ≠ 0)
    (hVdeg : V.degree + (↑((D.n + k + 1) / 2) : WithBot ℕ) ≤ D.n)
    (hmod0 : G.mod V = 0) (hdiv : G / V = f₁)
    (hfdeg : f₁.degree < k) :
    f₁.toPoly.degree < k ∧
      hammingDist r.get (fun i => f₁.toPoly.eval (D.val[i])) ≤ (D.n - k) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hVtp : V.toPoly ≠ 0 := (toPoly_eq_zero_iff _).not.mpr hVne0
  refine ⟨by rwa [← degree_toPoly], ?_⟩
  have hGV : G.toPoly = f₁.toPoly * V.toPoly :=
    (exactDiv_toPoly_iff _ _ _ hVtp).mpr ⟨hmod0, hdiv ▸ rfl⟩
  have hVnd : V.toPoly.natDegree ≤ (D.n - k) / 2 := by
    rw [degree_toPoly, Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hVtp, ← Nat.cast_add,
      Nat.cast_le] at hVdeg; omega
  have hbezP : G.toPoly
      = U.toPoly * (nodalPoly D).toPoly + V.toPoly * (receivedInterpolant D r).toPoly := by
    simp only [hbez, toPoly_add, toPoly_mul]
  exact (hammingDist_le_error_locator_natDegree _ D.node_injective _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    (nodalPoly_eval_node_eq_zero D) (receivedInterpolant_eval_node D r) hbezP hGV hVtp).trans hVnd

name: decode_sound
statement:
theorem decode_sound [Field F]
    (k : ℕ) (D : Domain F) (r : Vector F D.n) (hkn : k < D.n)
    (f₁ : CPolynomial F) (h : Gao.decode k D r = some f₁) :
    ∃ msg : Vector F k, messagePoly msg = f₁ ∧
      hammingDist r.get (encode D msg).get ≤ (D.n - k) / 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hbez, -, hVdeg, hVne0⟩ := partialGcd_stopSpec _ _ r hkn
  simp only [Gao.decode] at h
  set p := partialGcd k D r; set G := p.1; set U := p.2.1; set V := p.2.2
  replace hVne0 := (toPoly_eq_zero_iff _).not.mp hVne0
  rw [degree_nodalPoly, ← degree_toPoly] at hVdeg
  have hbezC : G = U * nodalPoly D + V * receivedInterpolant D r := by
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← toPoly_eq_zero_iff, toPoly_sub, toPoly_add, toPoly_mul, toPoly_mul,
      hbez, sub_self]
  split_ifs at h with hmod hfdeg
  have hdiv : G / V = f₁ := Option.some.inj h; have hfdeg' : f₁.degree < k := hdiv ▸ hfdeg
  have hdist := (decode_sound_aux _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hbezC hVne0 hVdeg (eq_of_beq hmod) hdiv hfdeg').2
  refine ⟨_, messagePoly_ofFn_coeff _ _ hfdeg', ?_⟩
  have hcw : (encode D (Vector.ofFn fun i : Fin k => f₁.coeff i)).get
      = fun i => f₁.toPoly.eval (D.val[i]) := by
    funext i; rw [encode_get, messagePoly_ofFn_coeff _ _ hfdeg', eval_toPoly]
  rwa [hcw]

name: decode_eq_none
statement:
theorem decode_eq_none [Field F]
    (k : ℕ) (D : Domain F) (r : Vector F D.n) (hkn : k < D.n)
    (h : ∀ msg : Vector F k,
      (D.n - k) / 2 < hammingDist r.get (encode D msg).get) :
    Gao.decode k D r = none
proof:
:= by
  rcases hgao : Gao.decode k D r with _ | f₁; rfl
  obtain ⟨msg, -, hle⟩ := decode_sound _ _ _ hkn _ hgao; exact absurd hle (h msg).not_ge

name: decode_eq_some
statement:
theorem decode_eq_some [Field F]
    (k : ℕ) (D : Domain F) (r : Vector F D.n) (hkn : k < D.n)
    (msg : Vector F k)
    (herr : 2 * hammingDist r.get (encode D msg).get ≤ D.n - k) :
    Gao.decode k D r = some (messagePoly msg)
proof:
:= by
  
  simp only [hammingDist] at herr
  set E := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin D.n => r.get i ≠ (encode D msg).get i) with hEdef
  
  have hagree : ∀ i ∈ Finset.univ \ E,
      (messagePoly msg).toPoly.eval (D.val[i])
        = (receivedInterpolant D r).toPoly.eval (D.val[i]) := by
    intro i hi; have hi' : r.get i = (encode D msg).get i := by simpa [hEdef] using hi
    rw [← eval_toPoly, ← encode_get, ← hi', ← receivedInterpolant_eval_node]
  have hdvd :=
    prod_X_sub_C_dvd_prod_mul_sub _ _ (Finset.subset_univ E) _ D.node_injective.injOn _ _ hagree
  have hwne : (∏ i ∈ E, (X - C (D.val[i]))) ≠ 0 :=
    (monic_prod_of_monic _ _ fun i _ => monic_X_sub_C _).ne_zero
  have hwdeg : (∏ i ∈ E, (X - C (D.val[i]))).degree = (E.card : WithBot ℕ) :=
    natDegree_finsetProd_X_sub_C_eq_card E (fun i => D.val[i]) ▸ Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hwne
  set w := ∏ i ∈ E, (X - C (D.val[i]))
  obtain ⟨U', hU'⟩ :
      (nodalPoly D).toPoly ∣ w * ((messagePoly msg).toPoly - (receivedInterpolant D r).toPoly) :=
    toPoly_nodalPoly D ▸ hdvd
  have hBez' : U' * (nodalPoly D).toPoly + w * (receivedInterpolant D r).toPoly
      = w * (messagePoly msg).toPoly := by rw [mul_comm U', ← hU']; ring
  
  obtain ⟨hbez, hstop, hVdeg, hVne0⟩ := partialGcd_stopSpec _ _ r hkn
  set p := partialGcd k D r; set G := p.1; set U := p.2.1; set V := p.2.2
  have hGdeg : G.toPoly.degree < ((D.n + k + 1) / 2 : ℕ) :=
    Polynomial.degree_le_natDegree.trans_lt (mod_cast hstop)
  have hG'deg : (w * (messagePoly msg).toPoly).degree < ((D.n + k + 1) / 2 : ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_mul, hwdeg]
    exact (WithBot.add_lt_add_left (by simp only [ne_eq, WithBot.natCast_ne_bot, not_false_eq_true])
      (degree_toPoly (messagePoly msg) ▸ messagePoly_degree_lt msg)).trans_le (mod_cast by omega)
  have hV'deg : w.degree + ((D.n + k + 1) / 2 : ℕ) ≤ (nodalPoly D).toPoly.degree := by
    rw [hwdeg, degree_nodalPoly]; exact mod_cast by omega
  have hcross := bezout_solutions_cross_mul _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (toPoly_nodalPoly_ne_zero D)
    hbez.symm hBez' hGdeg hG'deg hVdeg hV'deg
  have hGVf : G.toPoly = V.toPoly * (messagePoly msg).toPoly :=
    mul_left_cancel₀ hwne (by rw [← hcross]; ring)
  
  obtain ⟨hmod0, hdivtp⟩ :=
    (exactDiv_toPoly_iff _ _ _ hVne0).mp (hGVf.trans (mul_comm _ _))
  have hdiveq : G / V = messagePoly msg := toPolyLinearEquiv.injective (by
    simpa only [toPolyLinearEquiv_apply] using hdivtp)
  show (if G.mod V == 0 then if (G / V).degree < k then some (G / V) else none else none) = _
  rw [if_pos (beq_iff_eq.mpr hmod0), if_pos (hdiveq ▸ messagePoly_degree_lt msg), hdiveq]

name: decode_none_farness
statement:
theorem decode_none_farness [Field F]
    (k : ℕ) (D : Domain F) (r : Vector F D.n) (hkn : k < D.n)
    (hnone : Gao.decode k D r = none) :
    ∀ msg : Vector F k, D.n - k < 2 * hammingDist r.get (encode D msg).get
proof:
:= by
  intro msg
  by_contra hle
  rw [Gao.decode_eq_some k D r hkn msg (Nat.le_of_not_lt hle)] at hnone
  exact Option.some_ne_none _ hnone

name: decode_eq_none_iff
statement:
theorem decode_eq_none_iff [Field F]
    (k : ℕ) (D : Domain F) (r : Vector F D.n) (hkn : k < D.n) :
    Gao.decode k D r = none ↔
      ∀ msg : Vector F k, D.n - k < 2 * hammingDist r.get (encode D msg).get
proof:
:=
  ⟨decode_none_farness k D r hkn,
    fun h => decode_eq_none k D r hkn fun msg => by have := h msg; omega⟩

name: decode_unique
statement:
theorem decode_unique [Field F] (k : ℕ) (D : Domain F) (r : Vector F D.n)
    (hkn : k < D.n) (msg₁ msg₂ : Vector F k)
    (h₁ : 2 * hammingDist r.get (encode D msg₁).get ≤ D.n - k)
    (h₂ : 2 * hammingDist r.get (encode D msg₂).get ≤ D.n - k) :
    messagePoly msg₁ = messagePoly msg₂
proof:
:=
  Option.some.inj <|
    (decode_eq_some k D r hkn msg₁ h₁).symm.trans (decode_eq_some k D r hkn msg₂ h₂)

name: lastNonzero_none
statement:
theorem lastNonzero_none [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} :
    (∀ i, (hi : i < p.size) → p[i] = 0) → p.lastNonzero = none
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply Array.findIdxRev?_eq_none
  intros
  rw [bne_iff_ne, ne_eq, not_not]
  apply_assumption

name: lastNonzero_some
statement:
theorem lastNonzero_some [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} {i} (hi : i < p.size)
    (h : p[i] ≠ 0) : ∃ k, p.lastNonzero = some k
proof:
:=
  Array.findIdxRev?_eq_some ⟨i, hi, bne_iff_ne.mpr h⟩

name: lastNonzero_spec
statement:
theorem lastNonzero_spec [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} {k} :
    p.lastNonzero = some k
  → p[k] ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ j, (hj : j < p.size) → j > k → p[j] = 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro (h : p.lastNonzero = some k)
  constructor
  · by_contra
    have h : p[k] != 0 := Array.findIdxRev?_def h
    rwa [‹p[k] = 0›, bne_self_eq_false, Bool.false_eq_true] at h
  · intro j hj j_gt_k
    have h : ¬(p[j] != 0) := Array.findIdxRev?_maximal h ⟨ j, hj ⟩ j_gt_k
    rwa [bne_iff_ne, ne_eq, not_not] at h

name: lastNonzero_unique
statement:
lemma lastNonzero_unique [Zero Q] {p : CPolynomial.Raw Q} {k k' : Fin p.size} :
    lastNonzeroProp k → lastNonzeroProp k' → k = k'
proof:
:= by
  suffices weaker : ∀ k k', lastNonzeroProp k → lastNonzeroProp k' → k ≤ k' by
    intro h h'
    exact Fin.le_antisymm (weaker k k' h h') (weaker k' k h' h)
  intro k k' ⟨ h_nonzero, h ⟩ ⟨ h_nonzero', h' ⟩
  by_contra k_not_le
  have : p[k] = 0 := h' k k.is_lt (Nat.lt_of_not_ge k_not_le)
  contradiction

name: lastNonzero_some_iff
statement:
theorem lastNonzero_some_iff [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} {k} :
    p.lastNonzero = some k ↔ (p[k] ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ j, (hj : j < p.size) → j > k → p[j] = 0))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply lastNonzero_spec
  intro h_prop
  have ⟨ k', h_some'⟩ := lastNonzero_some k.is_lt h_prop.left
  have k_is_k' := lastNonzero_unique (lastNonzero_spec h_some') h_prop
  rwa [← k_is_k']

name: lastNonzero_induct
statement:
theorem lastNonzero_induct [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] {motive : CPolynomial.Raw R → Prop}
    (case1 : ∀ p, p.lastNonzero = none → (∀ i, (hi : i < p.size) → p[i] = 0) → motive p)
  (case2 : ∀ p : CPolynomial.Raw R, ∀ k : Fin p.size, p.lastNonzero = some k → p[k] ≠ 0 →
    (∀ j : ℕ, (hj : j < p.size) → j > k → p[j] = 0) → motive p)
  (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) : motive p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ∀ i, (hi : i < p.size) → p[i] = 0
  · exact case1 p (lastNonzero_none h) h
  · push Not at h; rcases h with ⟨ i, hi, h ⟩
    obtain ⟨ k, h_some ⟩ := lastNonzero_some hi h
    have ⟨ h_nonzero, h_max ⟩ := lastNonzero_spec h_some
    exact case2 p k h_some h_nonzero h_max

name: induct
statement:
theorem induct [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] {motive : CPolynomial.Raw R → Prop}
    (case1 : ∀ p, p.trim = #[] → (∀ i, (hi : i < p.size) → p[i] = 0) → motive p)
  (case2 : ∀ p : CPolynomial.Raw R, ∀ k : Fin p.size, p.trim = p.extract 0 (k + 1)
    → p[k] ≠ 0 → (∀ j : ℕ, (hj : j < p.size) → j > k → p[j] = 0) → motive p)
  (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) : motive p
proof:
:= by induction p using lastNonzero_induct with
  | case1 p h_none h_all_zero =>
    have h_empty : p.trim = #[] := by unfold trim; rw [h_none]
    exact case1 p h_empty h_all_zero
  | case2 p k h_some h_nonzero h_max =>
    have h_extract : p.trim = p.extract 0 (k + 1) := by unfold trim; rw [h_some]
    exact case2 p k h_extract h_nonzero h_max

name: elim
statement:
theorem elim [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    (p.trim = #[] ∧  (∀ i, (hi : i < p.size) → p[i] = 0))
    ∨ (∃ k : Fin p.size,
        p.trim = p.extract 0 (k + 1)
      ∧ p[k] ≠ 0
      ∧ (∀ j : ℕ, (hj : j < p.size) → j > k → p[j] = 0))
proof:
:= by induction p using induct with
  | case1 p h_empty h_all_zero => left; exact ⟨h_empty, h_all_zero⟩
  | case2 p k h_extract h_nonzero h_max => right; exact ⟨k, h_extract, h_nonzero, h_max⟩

name: size_eq_degree_plus_one
statement:
theorem size_eq_degree_plus_one [Zero R] [BEq R]
    (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) (h_trim : p.trim ≠ (mk #[])) :
    p.trim.size = p.degree + 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold trim degree
  match h : p.lastNonzero with
  | none => exfalso; unfold trim at h_trim; rw [h] at h_trim; contradiction
  | some i => simp [Fin.is_lt]

name: size_eq_natDegree_plus_one
statement:
theorem size_eq_natDegree_plus_one [Zero R] [BEq R]
    (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) (h_trim : p.trim ≠ (mk #[])) :
    p.trim.size = p.natDegree + 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold trim natDegree
  match h : p.lastNonzero with
  | none => exfalso; unfold trim at h_trim; rw [h] at h_trim; contradiction
  | some i => simp [Fin.is_lt]

name: size_eq_natDegree_of_zero
statement:
theorem size_eq_natDegree_of_zero [Zero R] [BEq R]
    (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) (h_trim : p.trim = (mk #[])) :
    p.trim.size = p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  unfold trim natDegree
  match h : p.lastNonzero with
  | none => simp
  | some i => exfalso
              unfold trim at h_trim
              rw [h] at h_trim; have h_size := congrArg Array.size h_trim
              simp [Array.size_extract, Nat.succ_le_of_lt i.is_lt] at h_size

name: size_le_size
statement: theorem size_le_size [Zero R] [BEq R] (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) : p.trim.size ≤ p.size
proof:
:= by
  unfold trim
  match h : p.lastNonzero with
  | none => simp
  | some i => simp [Array.size_extract]

name: coeff_eq_getElem_of_lt
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_getElem_of_lt [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} {i} (hi : i < p.size) :
    p.trim.coeff i = p[i]
proof:
:= by
  induction p using induct with
  | case1 p h_empty h_all_zero =>
    specialize h_all_zero i hi
    simp [h_empty, h_all_zero]
  | case2 p k h_extract h_nonzero h_max =>
    simp [h_extract]
    have h_size : k + 1 = (p.extract 0 (k + 1)).size := by
      simp [Array.size_extract]
    rcases (Nat.lt_or_ge k i) with hik | hik
    · have hik' : i ≥ (p.extract 0 (k + 1)).size := by linarith
      rw [Array.getElem?_eq_none hik', Option.getD_none]
      exact h_max i hi hik |> Eq.symm
    · have hik' : i < (p.extract 0 (k + 1)).size := by linarith
      rw [Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hik', Option.getD_some, Array.getElem_extract]
      simp only [zero_add]

name: coeff_eq_coeff
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_coeff [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) (i : ℕ) :
    p.trim.coeff i = p.coeff i
proof:
:= by
  rcases (Nat.lt_or_ge i p.size) with hi | hi
  · rw [coeff_eq_getElem_of_lt hi]
    simp [hi]
  · have hi' : i ≥ p.trim.size := by linarith [size_le_size p]
    simp [hi, hi']

name: coeff_eq_getElem
statement:
lemma coeff_eq_getElem [Zero Q] {p : CPolynomial.Raw Q} {i} (hp : i < p.size) :
    p.coeff i = p[i]
proof:
:= by
  simp [hp]

name: coeff_eq_zero
statement:
lemma coeff_eq_zero [Zero Q] {p : CPolynomial.Raw Q} :
    (∀ i, (hi : i < p.size) → p[i] = 0) ↔ ∀ i, p.coeff i = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h i
  · cases Nat.lt_or_ge i p.size <;> simp [*]
  · intro hi; specialize h i; simp [hi] at h; assumption

name: eq_degree_of_equiv
statement:
lemma eq_degree_of_equiv [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] {p q : CPolynomial.Raw R} :
    equiv p q → p.degree = q.degree
proof:
:= by
  unfold equiv degree
  intro h_equiv
  induction p using lastNonzero_induct with
  | case1 p h_none_p h_all_zero =>
    have h_zero_p : ∀ i, p.coeff i = 0 := coeff_eq_zero.mp h_all_zero
    have h_zero_q : ∀ i, q.coeff i = 0 := by intro i; rw [← h_equiv, h_zero_p]
    have h_none_q : q.lastNonzero = none := lastNonzero_none (coeff_eq_zero.mpr h_zero_q)
    rw [h_none_p, h_none_q]
  | case2 p k h_some_p h_nonzero_p h_max_p =>
    have h_equiv_k := h_equiv k
    have k_lt_q : k < q.size := by
      by_contra h_not_lt
      have h_ge := Nat.le_of_not_lt h_not_lt
      simp [h_ge] at h_equiv_k
      contradiction
    simp [k_lt_q] at h_equiv_k
    have h_nonzero_q : q[k.val] ≠ 0 := by rwa [← h_equiv_k]
    have h_max_q : ∀ j, (hj : j < q.size) → j > k → q[j] = 0 := by
      intro j hj j_gt_k
      have h_eq := h_equiv j
      simp [hj] at h_eq
      rw [← h_eq]
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j p.size with hj | hj
      · simp [hj, h_max_p j hj j_gt_k]
      · simp [hj]
    have h_some_q : q.lastNonzero = some ⟨ k, k_lt_q ⟩ :=
      lastNonzero_some_iff.mpr ⟨ h_nonzero_q, h_max_q ⟩
    rw [h_some_p, h_some_q]

name: eq_of_equiv
statement:
theorem eq_of_equiv [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] {p q : CPolynomial.Raw R} :
    equiv p q → p.trim = q.trim
proof:
:= by
  unfold equiv
  intro h
  ext
  · have h_deg := eq_degree_of_equiv h
    unfold trim
    cases hp : p.lastNonzero with
    | none =>
      cases hq : q.lastNonzero with
      | none => rfl
      | some j => unfold degree at h_deg; simp [hp, hq] at h_deg
    | some i =>
      cases hq : q.lastNonzero with
      | none => unfold degree at h_deg; simp [hp, hq] at h_deg
      | some j =>
        unfold degree at h_deg
        simp only [hp, hq] at h_deg
        simp [Array.size_extract, Nat.succ_le_of_lt i.is_lt, Nat.succ_le_of_lt j.is_lt]
        exact_mod_cast h_deg
  · rw [← coeff_eq_getElem, ← coeff_eq_getElem]
    rw [coeff_eq_coeff, coeff_eq_coeff, h _]

name: trim_equiv
statement:
theorem trim_equiv [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    equiv p.trim p
proof:
:= by
  apply coeff_eq_coeff

name: trim_twice
statement:
theorem trim_twice [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    p.trim.trim = p.trim
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_equiv
  apply trim_equiv

name: canonical_empty
statement: theorem canonical_empty [Zero R] [BEq R] : (mk (R := R) #[]).trim = #[]
proof:
:= by
  have : (mk (R:=R) #[]).lastNonzero = none := by
    simp [lastNonzero]
    apply Array.findIdxRev?_empty_none
    rfl
  rw [trim, this]

name: canonical_of_size_zero
statement:
theorem canonical_of_size_zero [Zero R] [BEq R] {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} :
    p.size = 0 → p.trim = p
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  suffices h_empty : p = #[] by rw [h_empty]; exact canonical_empty
  exact Array.eq_empty_of_size_eq_zero h

name: canonical_nonempty_iff
statement:
theorem canonical_nonempty_iff [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} (hp : p.size > 0) :
    p.trim = p ↔ p.lastNonzero = some ⟨ p.size - 1, Nat.pred_lt_self hp ⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold trim
  induction p using lastNonzero_induct with
  | case1 p h_none h_all_zero =>
    simp [h_none]
    by_contra h_empty
    subst h_empty
    contradiction
  | case2 p k h_some h_nonzero h_max =>
    simp [h_some]
    constructor
    · intro h
      ext
      have : p ≠ #[] := Array.ne_empty_of_size_pos hp
      simp [this] at h
      have : k + 1 ≤ p.size := Nat.succ_le_of_lt k.is_lt
      have : p.size = k + 1 := Nat.le_antisymm h this
      simp [this]
    · intro h
      have : k + 1 = p.size := by rw [h]; exact Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos hp
      rw [this]
      right
      exact le_refl _

name: lastNonzero_last_iff
statement:
theorem lastNonzero_last_iff [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} (hp : p.size > 0) :
    p.lastNonzero = some ⟨ p.size - 1, Nat.pred_lt_self hp ⟩ ↔ p.getLast hp ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  induction p using lastNonzero_induct with
  | case1 => simp [Array.getLast, *]
  | case2 p k h_some h_nonzero h_max =>
    simp only [h_some, Option.some_inj, Array.getLast]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have : k = p.size - 1 := by rw [h]
      conv => lhs; congr; case i => rw [← this]
      assumption
    · intro h
      rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy k (p.size - 1) with h_lt | h_eq | h_gt
      · specialize h_max (p.size - 1) (Nat.pred_lt_self hp) h_lt
        contradiction
      · ext; assumption
      · have : k < p.size := k.is_lt
        have : k ≥ p.size := Nat.le_of_pred_lt h_gt
        linarith

name: canonical_iff
statement:
theorem canonical_iff [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} :
    p.trim = p ↔ IsCanonical p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h hp
    rwa [← lastNonzero_last_iff hp, ← canonical_nonempty_iff hp]
  · rintro h
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos p.size with h_zero | hp
    · exact canonical_of_size_zero h_zero
    · rw [canonical_nonempty_iff hp, lastNonzero_last_iff hp]
      exact h hp

name: isCanonical_empty
statement: theorem isCanonical_empty [Zero R] : IsCanonical (mk (R := R) #[])
proof:
:= by
  intro hp
  simp at hp

name: isCanonical_of_size_zero
statement:
theorem isCanonical_of_size_zero [Zero R] {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} (hp : p.size = 0) :
    IsCanonical p
proof:
:= by
  intro hPos
  simp [hp] at hPos

name: isCanonical_iff_trim_eq
statement:
theorem isCanonical_iff_trim_eq [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} :
    IsCanonical p ↔ p.trim = p
proof:
:=
  canonical_iff.symm

name: isCanonical_iff_size_eq_zero_or_getLastD_ne_zero
statement:
theorem isCanonical_iff_size_eq_zero_or_getLastD_ne_zero [Zero R]
    {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} :
    IsCanonical p ↔ p.size = 0 ∨ p.getLastD 0 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos p.size with h0 | hp
    · exact Or.inl h0
    · exact Or.inr (by simpa [Array.getLastD, Array.getLast, hp] using h hp)
  · intro h hp
    rcases h with h0 | hlast
    · exact (Nat.ne_of_gt hp h0).elim
    · simpa [Array.getLastD, Array.getLast, hp] using hlast

name: trim_eq_iff_size_eq_zero_or_getLastD_ne_zero
statement:
theorem trim_eq_iff_size_eq_zero_or_getLastD_ne_zero [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} :
    p.trim = p ↔ p.size = 0 ∨ p.getLastD 0 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [canonical_iff, isCanonical_iff_size_eq_zero_or_getLastD_ne_zero]

name: trim_eq_of_isCanonical
statement:
theorem trim_eq_of_isCanonical [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} (hp : IsCanonical p) :
    p.trim = p
proof:
:=
  canonical_iff.mpr hp

name: isCanonical_of_trim_eq
statement:
theorem isCanonical_of_trim_eq [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} (hp : p.trim = p) :
    IsCanonical p
proof:
:=
  canonical_iff.mp hp

name: isCanonical_trim
statement:
theorem isCanonical_trim [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) : IsCanonical p.trim
proof:
:=
  isCanonical_of_trim_eq (trim_twice p)

name: push_trim
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma push_trim [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R] (arr : Array R) (c : R) :
    ¬c = 0 → trim (arr.push c) = arr.push c
proof:
:= by
  rw [Trim.canonical_iff]
  intros h_c hp
  simp [Array.getLast]
  exact h_c

name: non_zero_map
statement:
theorem non_zero_map [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    (f : R → R) (hf : ∀ r, f r = 0 → r = 0) (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    let fp
proof:
:= mk (p.map f);
  p.trim = p → fp.trim = fp := by
  intro fp p_canon
  by_cases hp : p.size > 0
  · apply canonical_iff.mpr
    intro hfp
    have h_nonzero := canonical_iff.mp p_canon hp
    have : fp.getLast hfp = f (p.getLast hp) := by simp [Array.getLast, fp]
    rw [this]
    by_contra h_zero
    specialize hf (p.getLast hp) h_zero
    contradiction
  have : p.size = 0 := by linarith
  have : fp.size = 0 := by simp [this, fp]
  apply canonical_of_size_zero this

name: canonical_ext
statement:
theorem canonical_ext [Zero R] [BEq R] [LawfulBEq R]
    {p q : CPolynomial.Raw R} (hp : p.trim = p) (hq : q.trim = q) :
    equiv p q → p = q
proof:
:= by
  intro h_equiv
  rw [← hp, ← hq]
  exact eq_of_equiv h_equiv

name: isCanonical_ext
proof:
:= by
  exact canonical_ext (trim_eq_of_isCanonical hp) (trim_eq_of_isCanonical hq)

name: pow_zero
statement:
lemma pow_zero (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    p ^ 0 = C 1
proof:
:= by
      exact rfl

name: pow_succ
statement:
lemma pow_succ (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) (n : ℕ) :
    p ^ (n + 1) = p * (p ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  change (mul p)^[n + 1] (C 1) = mul p ((mul p)^[n] (C 1))
  rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: matchSize_size_eq
statement:
lemma matchSize_size_eq {p q : CPolynomial.Raw Q} :
    let (p', q')
proof:
:= Array.matchSize p q 0
    p'.size = q'.size := by
  change (Array.rightpad _ _ _).size = (Array.rightpad _ _ _).size
  rw [Array.size_rightpad, Array.size_rightpad]
  omega

name: matchSize_size
statement:
lemma matchSize_size {p q : CPolynomial.Raw Q} :
    let (p', _)
proof:
:= Array.matchSize p q 0
    p'.size = max p.size q.size := by
  change (Array.rightpad _ _ _).size = max (Array.size _) (Array.size _)
  rw [Array.size_rightpad]
  omega

name: zipWith_size
statement:
lemma zipWith_size {R} {f : R → R → R} {a b : Array R} (h : a.size = b.size) :
    (Array.zipWith f a b).size = a.size
proof:
:= by
  simp; omega

name: concat_coeff
statement:
lemma concat_coeff₁ (i : ℕ) : i < p.size →
    (p ++ q).coeff i = p.coeff i
proof: := by simp; grind

name: concat_coeff
statement:
lemma concat_coeff₂ (i : ℕ) : i ≥ p.size →
    (p ++ q).coeff i = q.coeff (i - p.size)
proof: := by simp; grind

name: add_size
statement: theorem add_size {p q : CPolynomial.Raw Q} : (addRaw p q).size = max p.size q.size
proof:
:= by
  change (Array.zipWith _ _ _ ).size = max p.size q.size
  rw [zipWith_size matchSize_size_eq, matchSize_size]

name: add_coeff
statement:
theorem add_coeff {p q : CPolynomial.Raw Q} {i : ℕ} (hi : i < (addRaw p q).size) :
    (addRaw p q)[i] = p.coeff i + q.coeff i
proof:
:= by
  simp [addRaw]
  by_cases hi' : i < p.size <;> by_cases hi'' : i < q.size <;>
    simp_all [Array.rightpad_getElem_eq_getD]

name: add_coeff
statement:
theorem add_coeff? (p q : CPolynomial.Raw Q) (i : ℕ) :
    (addRaw p q).coeff i = p.coeff i + q.coeff i
proof:
:= by
  rcases (Nat.lt_or_ge i (addRaw p q).size) with h_lt | h_ge
  · rw [← add_coeff h_lt]; simp [h_lt]
  have h_lt' : i ≥ max p.size q.size := by rwa [← add_size]
  have h_p : i ≥ p.size := by omega
  have h_q : i ≥ q.size := by omega
  simp [h_ge, h_p, h_q]

name: add_coeff_trimmed
statement:
lemma add_coeff_trimmed [LawfulBEq R] (p q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (i : ℕ) :
    (p + q).coeff i = p.coeff i + q.coeff i
proof:
:= by
      have h_add : p + q = (p.addRaw q).trim := by rfl
      have h_trim_coeff : ∀ (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) (i : ℕ), p.coeff i = p.trim.coeff i := by
          exact fun p i => Eq.symm (Trim.coeff_eq_coeff p i)
      convert h_trim_coeff ( p.addRaw q ) i using 1
      · rw[h_add, ←h_trim_coeff]
      · rw [← h_trim_coeff, add_coeff? ]

name: add_equiv_raw
statement:
lemma add_equiv_raw [LawfulBEq R] (p q : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    Trim.equiv (p.add q) (p.addRaw q)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Trim.equiv add
  exact Trim.coeff_eq_coeff (p.addRaw q)

name: smul_equiv
statement:
lemma smul_equiv : ∀ (i : ℕ) (r : R),
    (smul r p).coeff i = r * (p.coeff i)
proof:
:= by
  intro i r
  unfold smul mk coeff
  rcases (Nat.lt_or_ge i p.size) with hi | hi <;> simp [hi]

name: nsmulRaw_equiv
statement:
lemma nsmulRaw_equiv [LawfulBEq R] : ∀ (n i : ℕ),
    (nsmulRaw n p).trim.coeff i = n * p.trim.coeff i
proof:
:= by
  intro n i
  unfold nsmulRaw
  repeat rw [Trim.coeff_eq_coeff]
  unfold mk
  rcases (Nat.lt_or_ge i p.size) with hi | hi <;> simp [hi]

name: mul_pow_assoc
statement:
lemma mul_pow_assoc : ∀ (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) (n : ℕ),
    ∀ (q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (m l : ℕ),
  l + m = n →
  p.mul^[n] q = p.mul^[m] (p.mul^[l] q)
proof:
:= by
  intro p n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro q m l h_sizes
    rw [Nat.add_eq_zero_iff] at h_sizes
    obtain ⟨hl, hm⟩ := h_sizes
    rw [hl, hm]
    simp
  | succ n₀ ih =>
    intro q m l h_sizes
    cases l with
    | zero =>
      simp at h_sizes
      rw [h_sizes]
      simp
    | succ l₀ =>
      have h_sizes_simp : l₀ + m = n₀ := by linarith
      clear h_sizes
      simpa using ih (p.mul q) m l₀ h_sizes_simp

name: mul_pow_succ
statement:
lemma mul_pow_succ (p q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (n : ℕ):
    p.mul^[n + 1] q = p.mul (p.mul^[n] q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_pow_assoc p (n+1) q 1 n] <;> simp

name: trim_add_trim
statement: lemma trim_add_trim [LawfulBEq R] (p q : CPolynomial.Raw R) : p.trim + q = p + q
proof:
:= by
  apply Trim.eq_of_equiv
  intro i
  rw [add_coeff?, add_coeff?, Trim.coeff_eq_coeff]

name: zero_def
statement: @[simp] theorem zero_def : (0 : CPolynomial.Raw Q) = #[]
proof: := rfl

name: add_comm
statement: theorem add_comm : p + q = q + p
proof:
:= by
  apply congrArg trim
  ext
  · simp only [add_size]; omega
  · simp only [add_coeff]
    apply _root_.add_comm

name: zero_canonical
statement: theorem zero_canonical : (0 : CPolynomial.Raw R).trim = 0
proof: := Trim.canonical_empty

name: leadingCoeff_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leadingCoeff_zero : leadingCoeff (0 : CPolynomial.Raw R) = (0 : R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingCoeff, zero_canonical]; rfl

name: monomial_canonical
statement:
theorem monomial_canonical [LawfulBEq R] [DecidableEq R] (n : ℕ) (c : R) :
    (monomial n c).trim = monomial n c
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : c = 0
  · simp [monomial, if_pos h, Trim.canonical_empty]
  · simp [monomial, if_neg h, mk]
    rw [Trim.push_trim _ _ h]

name: X_canonical
statement: theorem X_canonical [Nontrivial R] [LawfulBEq R] : X.trim = (X : CPolynomial.Raw R)
proof:
:= by
  unfold X
  change trim (#[0].push 1) = #[0].push 1
  apply Trim.push_trim
  simp

name: coeff_monomial
statement:
lemma coeff_monomial [DecidableEq R] {n i : ℕ} {c : R} :
    ((monomial n) c).coeff i = if n = i then c else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hc : c = 0
  · simp [monomial, hc]
  · unfold monomial
    rw [if_neg hc]; clear hc
    have h_arr : (mk (Array.replicate n 0 ++ #[c])) =
                   mk (Array.replicate n 0) ++ mk #[c] := by rfl
    rw [h_arr]; clear h_arr
    by_cases hn : n = i
    · rw [if_pos hn, hn]; clear hn
      have : (mk (Array.replicate i 0) ++ mk #[c]).coeff i = (mk #[c]).coeff 0 := by
        rw [concat_coeff₂]
        simp only [Array.size_replicate, tsub_self, Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?,
                   List.size_toArray, List.length_cons, List.length_nil, zero_add,
                   zero_lt_one, getElem?_pos, List.getElem_toArray,
                   List.getElem_cons_zero, Option.getD_some]
        have : Array.size (mk (Array.replicate i 0)) = i := by grind
        rw [← this]
        simp
      rw [this]
      simp
    · rw [if_neg hn]
      by_cases h_ineq : i < n
      · have : (mk (Array.replicate n 0 ++ #[c])).coeff i =
               (mk (Array.replicate n 0)).coeff i := by
          rw [concat_coeff₁]
          grind
        rw [this]; clear this
        simp [Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?]
        grind
      · have hi : i > n := by grind
        clear h_ineq hn
        grind

name: coeff_C
statement: lemma coeff_C (r : R) (i : ℕ) : (C r).coeff i = if i = 0 then r else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold C coeff; split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]

name: coeff_X
statement: lemma coeff_X (i : ℕ) : (X : CPolynomial.Raw R).coeff i = if i = 1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold coeff
  rcases i with ( _ | _ | i ) <;> rfl

name: coeff_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coeff_zero (i : ℕ) : (0 : CPolynomial.Raw R).coeff i = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [coeff, zero_def]

name: coeff_one
statement:
lemma coeff_one (i : ℕ) :
    coeff (1 : CPolynomial.Raw R) i = if i = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i = 0
  · rw [if_pos h, h]
    change coeff #[1] 0 = 1
    simp
  · rw [if_neg h]
    change coeff #[1] i = 0
    grind

name: zero_add
statement: theorem zero_add (hp : p.canonical) : 0 + p = p
proof:
:= by
  rw (occs := .pos [2]) [← hp]
  apply congrArg trim
  ext <;> simp [add_size, add_coeff, *]

name: add_zero
statement: theorem add_zero (hp : p.canonical) : p + 0 = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, zero_add p hp]

name: zero_add_trim
statement: theorem zero_add_trim [LawfulBEq R] (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) : 0 + p = p.trim
proof:
:= by
  apply congrArg trim
  ext <;> simp [add_size, add_coeff, *]

name: add_zero_trim
statement: theorem add_zero_trim [LawfulBEq R] (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) : p + 0 = p.trim
proof:
:= by
  apply congrArg trim
  ext <;> simp [add_size, add_coeff, *]

name: add_assoc
statement: theorem add_assoc [LawfulBEq R] : p + q + r = p + (q + r)
proof:
:= by
  change (addRaw p q).trim + r = p + (addRaw q r).trim
  rw [trim_add_trim, add_comm p, trim_add_trim, add_comm _ p]
  apply congrArg trim
  ext i
  · simp only [add_size]; omega
  · simp only [add_coeff, add_coeff?]
    apply _root_.add_assoc

name: foldl_preserves_canonical
statement:
lemma foldl_preserves_canonical {α : Type*}
    (f : CPolynomial.Raw R → α → CPolynomial.Raw R)
    (z : CPolynomial.Raw R) (as : Array α)
    (hz : z.trim = z)
    (hf : ∀ acc x, (f acc x).trim = f acc x) :
    (as.foldl f z).trim = as.foldl f z
proof:
:= by
      induction' as using Array.recOn with a as ih
      induction a using List.reverseRecOn <;> aesop

name: coeff_foldl_add
statement:
lemma coeff_foldl_add {α : Type*} [LawfulBEq R]
    (l : List α)
    (f : α → CPolynomial.Raw R)
    (z : CPolynomial.Raw R) (k : ℕ) :
    (l.foldl (fun acc x => acc + f x) z).coeff k
      = z.coeff k + (l.map (fun x => (f x).coeff k)).sum
proof:
:= by
      induction' l using List.reverseRecOn with l ih generalizing z
      · simp
      · simp +zetaDelta at *
        convert congr_arg₂ ( · + · ) ( ‹∀ z : CPolynomial.Raw R, (
          List.foldl ( fun ( acc : CPolynomial.Raw R ) ( x : α ) => acc + f x ) z l )[ k ]?.getD 0
            = z[k]?.getD 0 + ( List.map ( fun x => ( f x)[ k ]?.getD 0 ) l ).sum› z ) rfl using 1
        any_goals exact ( f ih )[ k ]?.getD 0
        · convert add_coeff_trimmed _ _ k
          rotate_left 3
          (expose_names; exact inst_1)
          (expose_names; exact inst_2)
          exact List.foldl ( fun acc x => acc + f x ) z l
          exact f ih
          · exact Eq.symm Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?
          · exact Eq.symm Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?
          · exact Eq.symm Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?
        · module

name: coeff_foldl_addRaw
statement:
lemma coeff_foldl_addRaw {α : Type*} [LawfulBEq R]
    (l : List α)
    (f : α → CPolynomial.Raw R)
    (z : CPolynomial.Raw R) (k : ℕ) :
    (l.foldl (fun acc x => acc.addRaw (f x)) z).coeff k
      = z.coeff k + (l.map (fun x => (f x).coeff k)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing z with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    rw [ih, add_coeff?, _root_.add_assoc]

name: foldl_trimAdd_canonical
proof:
:= by
  apply foldl_preserves_canonical
  · exact Trim.canonical_empty
  · intro acc x
    exact Trim.trim_twice (addRaw acc ((smul x.1 q).mulPowX x.2))

name: mul_eq_foldl
statement:
lemma mul_eq_foldl [LawfulBEq R] (p q : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    p * q = p.zipIdx.foldl (fun acc ⟨a, i⟩ => acc + (smul a q).mulPowX i) (mk #[])
proof:
:= by
  have hcoeff : Trim.equiv (mulRaw p q)
      (p.zipIdx.foldl (fun acc ⟨a, i⟩ => acc + (smul a q).mulPowX i) (mk #[])) := by
    intro k
    unfold mulRaw
    rw [← Array.foldl_toList, coeff_foldl_addRaw, ← Array.foldl_toList, coeff_foldl_add]
  show (mulRaw p q).trim = _
  rw [Trim.eq_of_equiv hcoeff, foldl_trimAdd_canonical]

name: sum_zipIdx_eq_sum_range
statement:
lemma sum_zipIdx_eq_sum_range {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α] (p : CPolynomial.Raw R)
    (f : R → ℕ → α) : (p.zipIdx.toList.map (fun ⟨a, i⟩ => f a i)).sum =
    (Finset.range p.size).sum (fun i => f (p.coeff i) i)
proof:
:= by
      refine' congr_arg _ ( List.ext_get _ _ ) <;> aesop

name: double_sum_eq
statement:
theorem double_sum_eq [LawfulBEq R] (p q r : CPolynomial.Raw R) (n : ℕ) :
    (Finset.range (n + 1)).sum (fun j =>
      (Finset.range (j + 1)).sum (fun i =>
        p.coeff i * q.coeff (j - i) * r.coeff (n - j)))
    =
    (Finset.range (n + 1)).sum (fun i =>
      (Finset.range (n - i + 1)).sum (fun k =>
        p.coeff i * q.coeff k * r.coeff (n - i - k)))
proof:
:= by
          have h_interchange : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
              ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), p.coeff i * q.coeff (j - i) * r.coeff (n - j)
                  = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
                      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i (n + 1),
                          p.coeff i * q.coeff (j - i) * r.coeff (n - j) := by
            simp_rw [Finset.range_eq_Ico]
            rw [Finset.sum_Ico_Ico_comm]
          convert h_interchange using 2
          rw [ Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sum_range ]
          simp +decide [ Nat.sub_add_comm ( Finset.mem_range_succ_iff.mp ‹_› ) ]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by rw [ Nat.sub_sub ]

name: sum_range_extend
statement:
lemma sum_range_extend  (p q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (k : ℕ) :
    (Finset.range p.size).sum (fun i => if k < i then 0 else p.coeff i * q.coeff (k - i)) =
    (Finset.range (k + 1)).sum (fun i => p.coeff i * q.coeff (k - i))
proof:
:= by
      by_cases h : p.size ≤ k + 1
      · rw [ ← Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ h ]
        rw [ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi =>
            if_neg ( by linarith [ Finset.mem_range.mp hi ] ), Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sum_range ]
        simp +decide [ coeff ]
      · rw [ Finset.sum_ite ]
        rw [ show Finset.filter ( fun x => ¬k < x ) ( Finset.range ( Array.size p ) )
            = Finset.range ( k + 1 ) from ?_ ]
        · simp +zetaDelta at *
        · ext; simp; omega

name: sum_range_reverse
statement:
lemma sum_range_reverse [LawfulBEq R] (p q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (k : ℕ) :
    (Finset.range (k + 1)).sum (fun i => p.coeff i * q.coeff (k - i)) =
    (Finset.range (k + 1)).sum (fun j => p.coeff (k - j) * q.coeff j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_range_reflect (fun j => p.coeff (k - j) * q.coeff j) (k + 1)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hj
  have hj' : j ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hj
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.sub_sub_self hj']

name: nsmul_zero
statement: theorem nsmul_zero [LawfulBEq R] (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) : nsmul 0 p = 0
proof:
:= by
  suffices (nsmulRaw 0 p).lastNonzero = none by simp [nsmul, trim, *]
  apply Trim.lastNonzero_none
  intros; unfold nsmulRaw
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, Array.getElem_map]

name: nsmulRawSucc
statement:
theorem nsmulRawSucc (n : ℕ) (p : CPolynomial.Raw Q) :
    nsmulRaw (n + 1) p = addRaw (nsmulRaw n p) p
proof:
:= by
  unfold nsmulRaw
  ext
  · simp [add_size]
  next i _ hi =>
    simp [add_size] at hi
    simp [add_coeff, hi]
    rw [_root_.add_mul (R:=Q) n 1 p[i], one_mul]

name: nsmul_succ
statement:
theorem nsmul_succ [LawfulBEq R] (n : ℕ) {p : CPolynomial.Raw R} :
    nsmul (n + 1) p = nsmul n p + p
proof:
:= by
  unfold nsmul
  rw [trim_add_trim]
  apply congrArg trim
  apply nsmulRawSucc

name: smul_coeff
statement:
lemma smul_coeff [LawfulBEq R] (a : R) (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) (k : ℕ) :
    (smul a p).coeff k = a * p.coeff k
proof:
:= by
  exact smul_equiv p k a

name: smul_addRaw_distrib
statement:
lemma smul_addRaw_distrib [LawfulBEq R] :
    ∀ (a' : R) (q r : CPolynomial.Raw R), smul a' (q.addRaw r)
        = (smul a' q).addRaw (smul a' r)
proof:
:= by
          intros a' q r
          simp [smul, addRaw]
          refine' congr_arg _ ( Array.ext _ _ );
            simp [Array.size_zipWith, Array.size_rightpad]
          · intro i hi₁ hi₂
            rw [Array.getElem_zipWith, Array.getElem_zipWith ]
            simp +decide [mul_add ]
            by_cases hi₃ : i < q.size <;> by_cases hi₄ : i < r.size <;>
              simp_all +decide [Array.rightpad_getElem_eq_getD]

name: smul_distrib_trim
statement:
lemma smul_distrib_trim [LawfulBEq R] :
    ∀ (a' : R) (q r : CPolynomial.Raw R), (smul a' (q + r)).trim
        = smul a' q + smul a' r
proof:
:= by
          intros a' q r
          have h_coeff : ∀ i, (smul a' (q + r)).coeff i
              = (smul a' q).coeff i
                  + (smul a' r).coeff i := by
            have h_smul : ∀ (a' : R) (q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (i : ℕ),
                (smul a' q).coeff i = a' * q.coeff i := by
              exact fun a' q i => smul_equiv q i a'
            have h_add : ∀ (q r : CPolynomial.Raw R) (i : ℕ), (q + r).coeff i
                = q.coeff i + r.coeff i := by
              exact fun q r i => add_coeff_trimmed q r i
            simp +decide [h_smul, h_add, mul_add ]
          have h_trim_eq : ∀ p q : CPolynomial.Raw R,
              (∀ i, p.coeff i = q.coeff i) → p.trim = q.trim := by
            exact fun p q a => Trim.eq_of_equiv a
          rw [← show (smul a' q + smul a' r).trim = smul a' q + smul a' r by
            show ((addRaw (smul a' q) (smul a' r)).trim).trim =
              (addRaw (smul a' q) (smul a' r)).trim
            exact Trim.trim_twice _]
          exact h_trim_eq _ _ (fun i => by rw [h_coeff, add_coeff_trimmed])

name: coeff_smul_add_distrib
statement:
lemma coeff_smul_add_distrib [LawfulBEq R] (a : R) (q r : CPolynomial.Raw R) (i : ℕ) :
    (smul a (q + r)).coeff i = (smul a q).coeff i + (smul a r).coeff i
proof:
:= by
      have h_expand : (smul a (q + r)).coeff i = a * ((q + r).coeff i) ∧
                         ((smul a q).coeff i) + ((smul a r).coeff i) =
                            a * (q.coeff i) + a * (r.coeff i) := by
                           have h_expand : ∀ (p : CPolynomial.Raw R), (smul a p).coeff i
                              = a * p.coeff i := by
                             exact fun p => smul_equiv p i a
                           exact ⟨ h_expand _, by rw [ h_expand, h_expand ] ⟩
      convert h_expand.1 using 1
      rw [ h_expand.2 ]
      rw [ add_coeff_trimmed ]
      simp +decide [ mul_add ]

name: coeff_add_smul
statement:
lemma coeff_add_smul [LawfulBEq R]  (a b : R) (q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (k : ℕ) :
    (smul (a + b) q).coeff k = (smul a q).coeff k + (smul b q).coeff k
proof:
:= by
      have h_distrib : ∀ (a b : R) (q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (k : ℕ),
          (a + b) * q.coeff k = a * q.coeff k + b * q.coeff k := by
        exact fun a b q k => add_mul a b _
      convert h_distrib a b q k using 1
      · exact smul_equiv q k (a + b)
      · congr! 1
        · exact smul_equiv q k a
        · exact smul_equiv q k b

name: coeff_sum
statement:
lemma coeff_sum : ∀ (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) (k : ℕ),
    (p.zipIdx.map (fun ⟨a, i⟩ => ((smul a 1).mulPowX i).coeff k)).sum = p.coeff k
proof:
:= by
  intro p k; induction' p with p ih generalizing k; simp +decide [ * ]
  induction' p using List.reverseRecOn with p ih generalizing k <;>
    simp +decide [ *, List.zipIdx_append ]
  by_cases hk : k < p.length <;> simp_all +decide [ List.getElem?_append_right ]
  · simp +decide [ hk, List.getElem?_append]
    rw [ mulPowX ]
    simp +decide [ Array.getElem?_append, hk ]
  · simp +decide [ mulPowX ]
    unfold smul; simp +decide [ Array.getElem?_append ]
    rw [ if_neg hk.not_gt ]; cases k - p.length <;> simp +decide
    · exact mul_one _
    · exact rfl

name: coeff_mul
statement:
lemma coeff_mul [LawfulBEq R] (p q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (k : ℕ) :
    (p * q).coeff k = (p.zipIdx.toList.map (fun ⟨a, i⟩ =>
        ((smul a q).mulPowX i).coeff k)).sum
proof:
:= by
      convert coeff_foldl_add _ _ _ _ using 1
      rotate_left 2
      exact inferInstance
      exact inferInstance
      exact R × ℕ
      (expose_names; exact inst_2)
      exact ( Array.zipIdx p ).toList
      exact fun x => smul x.1 q |> fun y
          => mulPowX x.2 y
      exact mk #[]
      exact k
      · congr
        simp only [Array.toList_zipIdx]
        have h_mul_def : ∀ (p q : CPolynomial.Raw R), p * q
            = (p.zipIdx.foldl (fun acc ⟨a, i⟩ => acc + (smul a q).mulPowX i) (mk #[])) :=
          fun p q => mul_eq_foldl p q
        convert h_mul_def p q using 1
        conv => rw [ ← Array.toList_zipIdx ]
        rw [Array.foldl_toList]
      · cases k <;> simp +decide [ * ]

name: coeff_mulPowX
statement:
lemma coeff_mulPowX [LawfulBEq R] (i : ℕ) (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) (k : ℕ) :
    (p.mulPowX i).coeff k = if k < i then 0 else p.coeff (k - i)
proof:
:= by
      split_ifs <;> simp_all +decide [ coeff, mulPowX ]
      · rw [ Array.getElem?_append ]; aesop
      · grind

name: coeff_mulPowX'
statement:
lemma coeff_mulPowX' [LawfulBEq R] (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) (n i : ℕ) :
    (p.mulPowX n).coeff i = if i < n then 0 else p.coeff (i - n)
proof:
:= by
      unfold mulPowX
      split_ifs <;> simp_all +decide [ coeff ]
      · rw [ Array.getElem?_append ]
        aesop
      · simp only [Array.getElem?_append, Array.getElem?_replicate,Array.size_replicate]
        split_ifs
        · omega
        · rfl

name: mulPowX_coeff'
statement:
lemma mulPowX_coeff' [LawfulBEq R] (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) (n k : ℕ) :
    (p.mulPowX n).coeff k = if k < n then 0 else p.coeff (k - n)
proof:
:= by
  exact coeff_mulPowX' p n k

name: coeff_mulPowX_smul_add
statement:
lemma coeff_mulPowX_smul_add [LawfulBEq R] (i : ℕ) (a b : R) (q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (k : ℕ) :
    ((smul (a + b) q).mulPowX i).coeff k =
        ((smul a q).mulPowX i).coeff k + ((smul b q).mulPowX i).coeff k
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_mulPowX, coeff_mulPowX, coeff_mulPowX]
  split_ifs
  · simp
  · rw [coeff_add_smul]

name: mulPowX_zero
statement:
lemma mulPowX_zero (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) :
    p.mulPowX 0 = p
proof:
:= by
    simp [mulPowX]

name: equiv_mul_one
statement: lemma equiv_mul_one [LawfulBEq R] (p : CPolynomial.Raw R) : Trim.equiv (p * 1) p
proof:
:= by
  have h_mul_one : ∀ (p : CPolynomial.Raw R), (p * 1).coeff = p.coeff := by
    intro p; funext i
    rw [ show p * 1 = p * 1 from rfl ]
    have mul_one_unwrap : ∀ (p : CPolynomial.Raw R), (p * 1).coeff = fun k =>
      (p.zipIdx.map (fun ⟨a, i⟩ => ((smul a 1).mulPowX i).coeff k)).sum := by
      intro p; funext k; exact (by
      convert coeff_foldl_add
          ( p.zipIdx.toList ) ( fun ⟨ a, i ⟩ => ( smul a 1 ).mulPowX i ) ( mk #[] ) k using 1
      · have h_mul_def : ∀ (p : CPolynomial.Raw R), p * 1 =
            (p.zipIdx.foldl (fun acc ⟨a, i⟩ => acc + (smul a 1).mulPowX i) (mk #[])) :=
          fun p => mul_eq_foldl p 1
        rw [h_mul_def, Array.foldl_toList]
      · simp +decide
        conv => rw [ ← Array.toList_zipIdx ]
        conv => rw [ ← Array.toList_map ]
        exact Eq.symm Array.sum_toList)
    exact (by exact mul_one_unwrap p ▸ coeff_sum p i ▸ rfl)
  exact congrFun (h_mul_one p)

name: mul_is_trimmed
statement: theorem mul_is_trimmed [LawfulBEq R] (p q : CPolynomial.Raw R) : (p * q).trim = p * q
proof:
:= by
  show ((mulRaw p q).trim).trim = (mulRaw p q).trim
  exact Trim.trim_twice (mulRaw p q)

name: add_is_trimmed
statement: theorem add_is_trimmed [LawfulBEq R] (p q : CPolynomial.Raw R) : (p + q).trim = p + q
proof:
:= by
  show ((addRaw p q).trim).trim = (addRaw p q).trim
  exact Trim.trim_twice (addRaw p q)

name: coeff_mul_eq_sum_range
statement:
lemma coeff_mul_eq_sum_range [LawfulBEq R] (p q : CPolynomial.Raw R) (k : ℕ) (n : ℕ)
    (h : p.size ≤ n) : (p * q).coeff k =
        List.sum ((List.range n).map (fun i => ((smul (p.coeff i) q).mulPowX i).coeff k))
proof:
:= by
      have h_coeff : (p * q).coeff k =
          ((p.zipIdx.toList).map
              (fun (x : R × ℕ) => ((smul x.1 q).mulPowX x.2).coeff k)).sum := by
        convert coeff_mul p q k using 1
      have h_split : List.sum (List.map
          (fun i => (mulPowX i (smul (p.coeff i) q)).coeff k) (List.range n)) =
        List.sum (List.map
